TALK_CAMP_TUTORIAL_EXPANSIONS.dynamic_line:
A camp can have up to 8 expansions (one for each of the 8 adjacent overmap tiles).  Expansions add to the capabilities of your camp, such as adding a farm field or a manufactory for crafting all kinds of things.
  Expansion missions show up in separate tabs in the bulletin board, one set of missions per location, and you'll need to hit 'tab' to see them.  Some base camps have dedicated expansions tailored to their specific facilities, and while these might be accessible from other base camps should those be constructed adjacent to one of these, the set of reasonably general expansions are currently all limited to open field locations (field, hay field, farm field, or field dirt road).  The currently available general expansions are:
  -- Farm: This is a full tile of plowed fields that you can maintain or send companions on missions to maintain.  Plants grow here normally.  This expansion exists in two versions.
  -- Garage: This is a large building that currently doesn't provide any functionality, and so is of limited use (it used to provide disassembly before that was supported via zones, which can still be placed inside the garage).  This expansion exists in two versions.
  -- Canteen: This is an expanded kitchen, dining area, and pantry that provides an expanded set of companion cooking recipes.  This expansion exists in two versions.
  -- Livestock Area: This is a modular set of buildings for holding livestock such as cows, horses, or chickens.  Animals are not included!  This expansion exists in two versions.
  -- Fabrication Workshop: This is a large expansion for doing all kinds of crafts.  Companions can use some of the furniture in this expansion to craft some items much faster than you can do by yourself by hand.  This expansion exists in two versions.
  -- Central Storage Building: This is a large building for storing goods.  This expansion exists in two versions, the second of which allows the construction of storage furniture with a larger capacity than storage on the ground.
  Note that there is nothing stopping you from constructing more than one instance of an expansion, such as multiple farms for more farming, or a second Livestock expansion if you have a lot of animals.  In most cases there is not much value in having more than one of an expansion, though.

TALK_CAMP_TUTORIAL_ADVICE.dynamic_line:
Starting a camp doesn't take much time, and you can use a faction camp to keep your companions fed without needing to regularly give them food, so it's a good idea to establish a minimal camp anywhere you intend to be for a while.
  How much you want to expand your camps is up to you.  A modular field camp can be very resource intensive, but building one up allows you to send companions off to hunt and farm for you, so there's quite the pay-off.  What kind of camp (or camps) you want to build depends both on what you intend to focus on and whether you want to be stationary or roaming with stops in areas only for some time before moving on.  If nothing else, you should consider building a water well as soon as you can, which may require you to perform construction prerequisites.
  If you have access to a fire station or evac shelter, you may want to build your camp in them.  Both of those camps are very compact, but have much of the same functionality as an upgraded field camp without requiring so many resources.
  If you are adding expansions to your camp, consider starting with a farm, canteen, or fabrication workshop.  The farm makes it easy to grow your own food if you don't have any ready plowed farms nearby, the canteen provides you with a well and root cellars after some upgrades, while the fabrication workshop can allow you to craft some of the resources you need to upgrade your camp.
  The livestock area and the storage area probably shouldn't be your first expansions, but they both have their uses.

TALK_CAMP_TUTORIAL_CHANGES.dynamic_line:
1.  Faction camps used to require a second companion to act as overseer and camp manager, but that's been replaced by the bulletin board and two-way radio.
2.  It used to be impossible to upgrade faction camps if there was a vehicle, even a cart, on the same map.  You can now upgrade camps even if there is a vehicle on the map, as long as the upgrade doesn't change the area under the vehicle.
3.  Faction camps used to upgrade by completely redrawing the map.  Damage to the camp would be replaced when the camp was upgraded.  Now upgrades only change the actual area being upgraded, and you will have to repair damage to the camp yourself.
4.  There used to be a single path for upgrading the main camp.  Now, after you have completed the first tent, you will have many options for your next upgrade, and you can have different companions working on different upgrades of the main camp at the same time.
5.  Companions who are near a camp will feed themselves from the camp's food stores, and if the camp has a well, they'll use it to quench their thirst.
6.  You can now set up faction camps in select buildings.  The list of available buildings is constantly growing, so you'll have to experiment.
7.  The oldest type of camp, known as the primitive field camp or "Old Camp", is no longer supported and will be removed entirely in the future.
8.  Most camps abided by a restriction that allowed them to add expansions to the camps only when camp constructions had added a sufficient number of beds to the camp (2 per expansion), but this restriction has been removed from all camps.
9.  Field base camps and standard expansions used to be available for fields only.  They can now be placed on fields (as before), hay fields, farm fields, and field dirt roads.

responses.text: We're always gonna be friends, right?  Even with the apocalypse… changing us?
What do you miss most about the internet?
Now that we've got no responsibilities, is there anything you'd like to see or do?
What do you think the rest of the world is like these days?
Do you miss any food from the old days?

dynamic_line: Sure.  Can I tell you about this idea I had for a comic I'm never gonna make?
Lately I've been thinking about my Steam library and all those games I was putting off for a bad time.  Now it's a bad time and I can't play 'em.  Tragedy of our era, right?
You remember that girl from high school I had that huge crush on?  Emily?  I wonder if she's still alive.  I shoulda asked her out.
Aw dude.  I was just remembering about this crowdfunded board game I backed right before things went to hell.  It'd be fulfilling right about now, I bet.
Does it ever seem to you like the stars are in different places from where they used to be?  I can find all the old constellations, but they look different now.

Since everything went down, I keep having this recurring dream where I'm at Foodplace again, and Luke Skywalker is there, demanding an EB2 combo with extra Beverage, and he's being a real Karen about it.  Do you think it means something?
Maybe it's weird but this whole thing sorta feels like an extended camping trip.  With zombies.
I slept weird last night.  Got this awful crick in my neck.
Do you think the internet is still out there somewhere, floating around in some still-functional servers somehow?  It's weird to think about what happened to all that data.
Remember that guy Daren in elementary who used to tell all those weird-ass creepy stories?  Chris hated him but I thought he was interesting.  I wonder if he's alive, he'd have loved this.
You know what I could really use right now?  A hot bath.
Next time we hit a library, I'm gonna see if they've got a copy of Gideon the Ninth.  I read that book a while ago, but I was super high and I don't remember much of it.
Do you remember what day of the week it is?
Next time I get a chance, I'm gonna make a nice big bowl of mac and cheese.
Y'know, these shoes are surprisingly comfy.  You wouldn't think it to look at 'em.
Do you think zombies know what's going on?  Like, are the original people still in there watching all this happen?  I sure hope not.
It's funny how fast all this weird shit starts to feel normal, don't you think?

dynamic_line.no: Aww, of course.  No matter what happens, you're always you and I'm always me, right?  We've been through worse than this."  He pauses, his brow furrowed.  "Well, okay, maybe we haven't.  But we've stuck through it all for so many years, what's a little apocalypse gonna change?  Or a little mutation, or grievous bodily harm, or zombies, or interdimensional monster attacks and serious life-altering PTSD, or whatever.  Who cares.  You're my family, more than my birth family ever was.
dynamic_line.yes: <talk_snippet_modded_liam_Friends4ever>

dynamic_line: OK, I know you're leading me up to say something dirty, and yeah I miss that, but you know what?  Really the thing I miss most is social media.  No seriously!  Stop looking at me like that!  I liked being able to just talk to people no matter where they were, any time.  I had friends in Sweden, and Brazil, and the West Coast.  I'm never gonna know what happened to them, and that busts me up bad.  They mattered to me, you know?"  His voice catches a bit, and he coughs.  "You're here though, and that helps a lot.  Can't imagine trying to do this lone-wolf.  How about you, what were you thinking of when you asked?

Well, I mean, there's the obvious stuff like, uh, video streaming," he winks at you, "but I think lately I'm missing Wikipedia.  I have all these random questions about things, and I can't answer them.  I feel like I'm living in a box.  How did we survive for thousands of years like this?

Online restaurant reviews."  He stares at you without a shred of irony.  "I'm serious, I used to love browsing looking for the funniest or weirdest reviews.  I guess I could broaden it, I miss pointless doom scrolling.  It's harder to find things to keep my mind off things now, and I've got more I wish I could keep my mind off.  What about you?

*laughs.  "You know me, I was never high on the ambition front.  Honestly, if you weren't around I'd probably clean up my dad's old cabin, try to learn how to set up a power supply, and scavenge for parts until I'd built the best damn gaming rig the world will ever see.  Then I'd load up whatever games I could find."  He pauses.  "Or maybe it'd be easier to set up a console, I dunno.  Most consoles aren't gonna like the no-internet thing right?  There's probably a way to crack 'em but without the internet where would we even check?"  He rubs his chin.  "Still.  I'd have maybe found a way.  How about you, what's the big overarching plan for all this?"

Oh, well.  I don't really think of life that way, you know?  I guess I'm pretty happy to just hang out with you, doing the shit we're doing, seeing what life brings.  Still, I guess I could see settling down somewhere nice, somewhere quiet, somewhere zombie-free.  I bet it wouldn't take long to get enough food and supplies to live on forever, and then I'd just let myself turn into some kinda wild bush man, with a big crazy long beard.  I'd smell like weed and B.O. and I'd have this giant stack of books to read.  Other survivors would come find me, like a guru on a mountaintop, to ask me questions about Batman.  In time, as the old world was forgotten, I'd convince them that he was a real person."  He grins.  "How 'bout you?

Oh dude, good question.  The news reports made it sound like this is everywhere, you know?  Still, somewhere out there's gotta be better than this, right?  Maybe like, up in the Yukon or Siberia or something it's all kinda normal?  I think most places are like this though, just one big fucked up mess.  Maybe they've got different monsters though, like, carnivorous rocks or some shit.  How 'bout you, what do you think is out there?

See, I like that about you.  Here we are just trying to keep alive and you're thinking all these big thoughts about the rest of the world.  I got no clue how they're doing out there, so I'm just gonna imagine that things are kinda like here, but maybe a bit better.  There's a few places where folks have settled in and they're figuring stuff out.  Those folks are gonna last a long time, maybe they're how we start rebuilding.

I never thought I'd hear myself say this, but I kinda miss the Ediburger3 from Foodplace.  I worked there so long, I hated everything, but as soon as you tell me I'm *never* gonna have a fresh, greasy EB3 again, suddenly it's all my stomach wants.  Don't try to track one down or anything though.  I'm pretty sure I miss the *idea* more than the actual *thing*.  And I don't think we could cook up a copy, it'd be pretty hard to get the right blend of animal product and sawdust for the Meatcylinder."  He stares wistfully into space for a moment.  "How about you, what were you thinking of when you asked?

Delivery pizza.  It's not the quality of the pizza I miss, it's the delivery.  Having someone just show up at the door with a god damn pizza, ready for you to eat.  We lived in paradise and we knew it not.  How about you?

You know, my friend, I could really go for an egg salad sandwich right now.  Nice, fresh eggs, some cheap-ass white bread, bit of pickle on there, hint of mustard.  Egg salad gets a bad rap because it sucks if you get it from the store, but you make a good homemade one?  That's something else, I tell you.  What's your poison?

You know, I'm kinda in the mood for some pub nachos right now.  The whole pub ambience would be good too, but I like how they'd put 'em on wax paper that'd be so soaked with cheese grease you could see right through it.  Those little black olive wheels that tasted like rubber, they were only ever good with pub nachos, you know?  Any other time, garbage.  I'd love to have a big tray of pub nachos, go to a karaoke night, and just sing fuckin' Abba songs until my throat hurt.  You in?

responses.text: We hadn't caught up in a while before <the_cataclysm>.  What've you been doing?
You picked up a lot of useful skills over the years, hey.

BGSS_Liam1.dynamic_line: Well, sure.  I dunno what more there is to tell, we've known each other for ages.

responses.text: How did you make it through the Cataclysm?
You picked up a lot of useful skills over the years, hey.

BGSS_Liam2.dynamic_line: *shrugs.  "Same as I was when we used to hang out more, mostly.  I quit my job at Foodplace a while back, got tired of the stupid outfits.  Worked doing labor in construction for a bit, but I didn't like my boss so I ditched it.  Got a job doing deliveries for Amazon, which was absolutely shitty, but I managed to jump from that to a bit of a better delivery job for a smaller company.  It was actually going pretty good before everything happened."

responses.text: You picked up a lot of useful skills over the years, hey.

BGSS_Liam3.dynamic_line: I wanna say it was a hell of a story, but really, I was on the way back to Boston from a delivery and a thing about the riots came on the radio.  I was close to the cabin so I just thought, 'this is starting to sound really fuckin' bad.'  I called in sick and took a few days to hunker down out of civilization.  By the time I had to think about going back to work, we were into that wild time when half the people were trying to keep things running and the other half were trying to burn everything down.  I shut the blinds and stayed in, until Chris showed up acting like a freak.

responses.text: What happened to your father?  You never talked about him much.

BGSS_Liam_Expertise.dynamic_line: It doesn't feel that way, but I guess so.  I don't know if I ever told you, but my dad was quite the weirdo prepper.  He built the cabin and when I was a kid we'd head out and do drills for the end of the world.  It's part of why I was kinda whacked out on apocalypse stuff when you and I first met, back when we made the plan for where to meet up and all.  He taught me archery and some survival skills but I never really took to it, partly because my ol' man was a real piece of work."  He stares off for a minute.  "To be honest, though, now that we're in the middle of a real-ass apocalypse, I can see a lot of what he taught me was just crap anyway.

responses.text: I remember your mom as kind of a quiet lady, she seemed all right.  Should we be trying to find her?

BGSS_Liam_Father.dynamic_line: *snorts.  "I was pretty low-contact with him the last couple years.  He got me that job in construction and when I left it, he tried to hit me, found out I'm not so much of a pushover as when I was fifteen.  Asshole.  I was still texting my mom a bit, apparently when things went to shit, he tried to join the riots.  I hope he got gunned down."

BGSS_Liam_Mother.dynamic_line: Well, things with her weren't as bad as with my dad, but I don't know if I'd go trying to hunt for her in a zombified city or anything.  Like, sure she didn't beat me up, but she didn't ever lift a finger to help me either.  She was still with him right up until the end, even when it was obvious that she was choosing him over me.  I don't wanna judge her for the life she led, but - " he trails off for a moment, then twitches his shoulders and resumes.  "Well, it's like I said.  I hope she's okay but I'm not gonna go risk my neck trying to find her.  You and Chris were my real family, you got me through those years.

TALK_Liam_Jenny_CrushAccuse.dynamic_line: *stares at you wide-eyed for a beat, then breaks into a shy grin.  "Aw man, busted.  You *know* I dig those distracted nerdy chicks who don't react to my presence in any way.  It's all good though, you know?  Don't tell her.  I barely know her and it's not like she's in a place to be dating some stranger."

TALK_Liam_Introdialogue.dynamic_line:
Years ago, you and your old group of friends made a pact.  It seemed like a joke at the time: if the world ended, you'd all meet up at Liam's cabin, if you could, and work together to help each other out.  Now, the unthinkable has happened, and somehow you've made it out in one piece.  It's been years since you saw those friends, though you've kept a little bit in touch on social media, and you can only hope that the others perhaps took the idea seriously.  Even if they did, it would be a hard trip.  The roads were blocked off by military forces trying to prevent the riots from spreading, and you had to make the last part of the journey on foot.

As the morning light breaks into day, you've reached Liam's cabin, a ramshackle building in the woods outside <city>.  You can see Liam's car in front, looking a bit more run down since you last saw him a few years ago.  You feel a swell of relief: at least Liam seems to have made it!  As you approach the door, you hear a shout of terror from inside, and then the unmistakable sound of a gunshot.  Were you a moment too late?

responses.text: Get ahold of yourself, man.  What's happening?  Chris?

dynamic_line.no: *, your old friend, stares at you with blank, confused eyes.  He is standing over a freshly mangled corpse, a smoking shotgun at his feet.  "Holy shit dude."  He blinks.  "Is this about Chris?  If you're here to kill me, just get it over with man.  I don't know what the fuck is happening but I can't take you out too."

RUBIK_ANUS_FETICK.name_plural: Bring 1000 units of anesthetic to Rubiks

dialogue.describe: If'n us'll to add the metal an' plastic for ye, us'll need a thousand unit o' them anus-feticks, half for your thinkin'-meat an' half for our stock.
dialogue.offer: If'n us'll to add the metal an' plastic for ye, us'll need a thousand unit o' them anus-feticks, half for your thinkin'-meat an' half for our stock.
dialogue.accepted: King's own luck!
dialogue.rejected: That be a choice an' you can tass.  Come back to this'n if you like.
dialogue.advice: Check round the chirurgery an' such, I'd razz.
dialogue.inquire: Us'n waits patient-like for that anus-fetick.
dialogue.success: Fine an' fine.  We can pass it in when you like.
dialogue.success_lie: Fine an' fine.  We can pass it in when you like.
dialogue.failure: Fine an' fine.  Come back to this'n if you like to try again.

dialogue.inquire: What've ye scolted, then, o'the clunker?
dialogue.success: Aye and fine!  One for the paper-claim an' so.  An I'm ken, these'n's could be a right thorn.  For ol' Rubik's sake, let's hope they be'n't for to drive us out o' your otherlands.
dialogue.success_lie: Hm.  The escoltin' our way be less.  This'n'll yark at the Scythy mayhaps.
dialogue.failure: Fine an' fine.  Come back to this'n if you like to try again.

EXODII_MISSION_CHOP_SHOP.name: Recover the Missing Exodii
EXODII_MISSION_CHOP_SHOP.description: Rubik believes a missing Exodii scout is being kept hostage, or worse, has been killed, by members of Hub 01.  Rubik says the scout will look a bit like him: a mostly-metal cyborg, but with a recognizable red frame.  I either need to rescue the Exodii, or bring back a piece of their "body" as proof that they have perished.

EXODII_MISSION_WAREHOUSE.name: Find the lost Exodii warehouse and reboot its locator antenna.
EXODII_MISSION_WAREHOUSE.name_plural: Find the lost Exodii warehouse and reboot its locator antenna.s

dialogue.accepted: King's own luck!
dialogue.rejected: That be a choice an' you can tass.  Come back to this'n if you like.
dialogue.advice: What ye'r searching is safehouse-like, sand, stone, metal an' all.
dialogue.success: Fine an' fine.  We can pass it in when you like.
dialogue.success_lie: Fine an' fine.  We can pass it in when you like.
dialogue.failure: Fine an' fine.  Come back to this'n if you like to try again.

EXODII_MISSION_MEET_FREE_MERCHANTS.name: Go to the Refugee Center and negotiate a trade deal between the Free Merchants and the Exodii.  Don't forget to take the Exodii "talk-rad talk-vid".
EXODII_MISSION_MEET_FREE_MERCHANTS.name_plural: Go to the Refugee Center and negotiate a trade deal between the Free Merchants and the Exodii.  Don't forget to take the Exodii "talk-rad talk-vid".s

EXODII_MISSION_STRING_DIMENSION_EXODII.name: Download data from the other-dimension Exodii node
EXODII_MISSION_STRING_DIMENSION_EXODII.name_plural: Download data from the other-dimension Exodii nodes

MISSION_EXODII_PAY_BACK_RIOT_GEAR.name: Pay Back The Riot Gear to Rubik
MISSION_EXODII_PAY_BACK_RIOT_GEAR.name_plural: Pay Back The Riot Gear to Rubiks

MISSION_EXODII_LABYRINTHS_INTRO.name: Exodii Labyrinths
MISSION_EXODII_LABYRINTHS_INTRO.description: Rubik told me about a place described as interdimensional "labyrinths", where I might find all manner of things, including bionics.  He said I can go scout them out if I'm interested in trying to bring back valuable salvage.  I should go downstairs in the castle, and find a terminal next to a metal ring.  Somehow, using that will send me there.

MISSION_nl_boiler.name: Find the Power Source
MISSION_nl_boiler.description: I've been tasked with finding some sort of power source.  Find and activate the <color_yellow>terminal</color> to take the power source back to the safehouse.

MISSION_nl_water_cooler.name: Find the Water Source
MISSION_nl_water_cooler.description: I've been tasked with finding some sort of water source, but it is hidden in this place.  Find and <color_yellow>"feed"</color> it to take the technology back to the safehouse.

directions_exodii_signpost.name: Follow the directions on the pictographic sign
directions_exodii_signpost.name_plural: Follow the directions on the pictographic signs
directions_exodii_signpost.description: I found a weird pictographic sign that seemed to point towards someone willing to trade.

dialogue.describe: I found a weird pictographic sign that seemed to point towards someone willing to trade.
dialogue.offer: This is a sign with a series of simple line-art pictograms showing what appears to be a basic trade transaction.  A pair of hands offers a piece of some kind of junk, and another pair of hands offers a small pouch in return.

dialogue.describe: I need a supply of salt.
dialogue.offer: I know this doesn't sound important, but I am running low on salt.  We don't just need it as a seasoning, it's also vital for food preservation.  Could you find about 15 pounds of salt for me?
dialogue.accepted: Don't forget to tell me when you have them.
dialogue.rejected: It's okay, I can do without them.  Just let me know if you reconsider.
dialogue.advice: There's a lot of places to look.  They are common in house kitchens, restaurants or grocery stores.
dialogue.inquire: How is the search going?  Have you found 'em?
dialogue.success: I really appreciate your help.  Don't worry, you won't leave empty-handed.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: Don't worry about it, it's not that important.

dialogue.offer: This task is bit more serious.  I don't have enough jars to preserve perishables for the future, and we can't just store everything in salt.  We could do our own canning if we had some more glass jars.  I think 40 jars should be enough.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks for accepting this task.  It'll take a load off my shoulders.  I finally won't have to worry about this problem anymore.
dialogue.rejected: Just let me know if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: Glass jars are not that hard to find.  I'd look for them in residential areas.
dialogue.success: Thank you for your help.  Here's your reward.  I have one more task to do.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: It's not a big deal, it isn't that urgent.

dialogue.offer: I don't have any butcher knives in here.  It's difficult to cut anything hard without it.  It's good to have one, even though I won't use it that often.  Could you get me one, or anything similarly suitable?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for accepting.  I can't cut anything with this dull knife.
dialogue.rejected: I guess I have to cut them with my steak knife.
dialogue.advice: Butcher knives are not that rare to find.  They are commonly found in kitchens.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have that knife now?
dialogue.success: I am grateful for the help you've done.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: Don't worry about it, it's not that important.

dialogue.describe: I'd like to read some mystery novels.
dialogue.offer: Sometimes it gets a little bit boring up here, and I like to read something to take my mind off of things.  Problem is, I've run out of books.  I've been wanting to read some mystery novels as of late, so could you get me three of them?
dialogue.accepted: Just bring them to me when you have it.
dialogue.rejected: Nevermind then.  I hope you'll change your mind.
dialogue.advice: I'd loot libraries and bookstores.
dialogue.inquire: So, have you found the books?
dialogue.success: Thank you.  This will keep me busy for a while.  Please take this as a token of my gratitude.
dialogue.success_lie: Could you give them to me?
dialogue.failure: Fine.  I can read something else.

MISSION_GODCO_FOOD_GUARD_CANNING_STARTUP.name: Canning Startup
MISSION_GODCO_FOOD_GUARD_CANNING_STARTUP.description: Find 100 medium tin cans to can with.

dialogue.describe: I'd like to have some cans to store food in.
dialogue.offer: Now that we have some canning pots from Helena, we can start storing foodstuffs more easily around here.  Recycling our old tin cans is great and all, but if we get a big influx of new foods, then we can't properly store it all.  As such, if you could find about 100 more empty medium tin cans for me, I'd really appreciate it.
dialogue.accepted: Just bring it to me when you have it.
dialogue.rejected: Nevermind then.  I hope you'll change your mind.
dialogue.advice: I'd look anywhere there's food waste or scrap piles.  We can wash out the cans when we get them.
dialogue.inquire: So, have you found the cans?
dialogue.success: Thank you, now we won't have to worry about running out of food in the winter.
dialogue.success_lie: Could you give them to me?
dialogue.failure: Fine.  I'll get them myself.

MISSION_GODCO_FOOD_GUARD_GET_TRAP_BOOK.name: Find a copy of The Modern Trapper
MISSION_GODCO_FOOD_GUARD_GET_TRAP_BOOK.name_plural: Find a copy of The Modern Trappers
MISSION_GODCO_FOOD_GUARD_GET_TRAP_BOOK.description: Find a copy of The Modern Trapper so Eddie can learn how to lay traps.

dialogue.describe: I'd like to read some trapping guides.
dialogue.offer: Since we've got all the stuff to store away food, I figure that it's time we get some more.  I've been talking it over with Russell, and I think setting out animal traps is a good way to go.  The problem is, nobody here knows how to do it.  I've heard that The Modern Trapper is a good place to start, so if you could get me a copy, I'd really appreciate it.
dialogue.accepted: Just bring it to me when you have it.
dialogue.rejected: Too trivial for you?
dialogue.advice: I'd loot libraries and bookstores.
dialogue.success: Thank you, me and Russell will start studying it soon.
dialogue.success_lie: Where is it?
dialogue.failure: Fine.  I can read something else.

MISSION_GODCO_FOOD_GUARD_BETTER_FOOD_STO.name: Store Up Your Grain
MISSION_GODCO_FOOD_GUARD_BETTER_FOOD_STO.description: Find 5,398 pounds of sheet metal (408 units) to help Eddie build a warehouse.

dialogue.describe: I'd like to have better food storage.
dialogue.offer: I've been drawing up some plans to expand our food storage around here.  Now that we won't starve to death anytime soon, our old crates just aren't cutting it, so we're going to build a small warehouse to store everything, and I've gathered a crew to build it.  We've got most of the materials covered, but we don't have enough sheet metal to make the shelves.  If you could get us about 5,000 pounds of the stuff, I'll pay you handsomely with what we have.  How does that sound?
dialogue.accepted: Just bring it to me when you have it.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I'll find someone else.
dialogue.advice: If you can find a steel mill, I'd look there.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the sheet metal?
dialogue.success: I can't thank you enough, here's the pay for it.  Here in a while, we'll have a spot to put all of our food.
dialogue.success_lie: Alright, where's it all at?
dialogue.failure: Sorry, I had to find someone else since you didn't come through.

MISSION_GODCO_GET_GUITAR_STRING.name: Obtain a guitar string
MISSION_GODCO_GET_GUITAR_STRING.description: Find a length of tempered steel wire to be used as a guitar string.

dialogue.describe: I need a new guitar string.
dialogue.offer: One of my guitar strings busted from where I smacked a zombie.  If you could get me a new string, I can fix my guitar.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks.  I'll give you a performance when you get back with it.
dialogue.rejected: I guess I'll just skip that note.
dialogue.advice: I read that musical wire is made of tempered steel.  Music shops should have some, or you could take apart a piano.
dialogue.success: Thank you so much!  This should last for a while.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: Don't worry about it, I'll do it myself.

MISSION_GODCO_DARRYL_WELL1.name: Well Construction
MISSION_GODCO_DARRYL_WELL1.description: Find eight pipes for Darryl Johnson.

dialogue.describe: I need eight pipes to start construction.
dialogue.offer: Now that's some enthusiasm, pal.  Ever since our water supply shut off, we've been using the nearby river for most of our water needs.  Who knows how many bloated corpses have decayed in that.  I want to construct a well, but I'm missing some building materials - eight pipes to be exact.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best, pal.  I appreciate it.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.
dialogue.advice: Try disassembling some lockers.  Just don't destroy our furniture, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: Great, I can finally start constructing this thing.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I guess it was just a pipe dream.

MISSION_GODCO_DARRYL_WELL2.name: Water Pump Construction
MISSION_GODCO_DARRYL_WELL2.description: Find a mechanical pump for Darryl Johnson.

dialogue.describe: I need a mechanical pump to finish construction.
dialogue.offer: It's less like a well, and more like a covered pit currently.  I'll need you to find a mechanical pump, one that will make this <freaking> thing work.
dialogue.accepted: Take care of yourself out there.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Try disassembling another well.
dialogue.success: Much obliged, survivor.  Thanks to you, we don't need to worry about where our water's gonna come from.  Here, take this as a token of our gratitude.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: I need nails to build a chicken coop
dialogue.offer: Now that we've got a steady supply of water, I've been thinking about raising some livestock.  I'm starting with some chickens I found on a farm the other day, but I don't have a coop for them.  If you can get me 150 nails, I can start building one.
dialogue.accepted: Take care of yourself out there.
dialogue.rejected: Its a simple job.
dialogue.advice: You could take apart some furniture in town, or make them yourself.
dialogue.success: Thank you.  I should have some eggs in a week, once I finish the coop.  Come back and buy some!
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_GODCO_RUSSELL_TROPHY1.name: Trophy Hunt I
MISSION_GODCO_RUSSELL_TROPHY1.description: Help Russell Connelly expand his trophy collection by gathering three hunks of slime glob.

dialogue.offer: I have the location for an alien crash site.  I want you to investigate and bring me anything you'd find interesting.
dialogue.accepted: Good luck out there!
dialogue.rejected: That's all right.  Not everyone is cut out for this.
dialogue.advice: Worst case scenario you'll be covered in slime.  There's nothing to fear, I hope.
dialogue.success: Good one!  Survivor, you have just passed my test.  I knew you could do it.  Your work shall be rewarded!
dialogue.success_lie: You liar!
dialogue.failure: You give up?  This country fell apart because no one could find a good man to rely on… might as well give up, I guess.

MISSION_GODCO_RUSSELL_TROPHY2.name: Trophy Hunt II
MISSION_GODCO_RUSSELL_TROPHY2.description: Continue the quest for trophies by finding an unhatched spider egg.

dialogue.offer: <the_cataclysm> didn't spare us humans.  Our former selves would look at us in disgust at the things we do for survival.  At least, that's what I was told.  I heard reports of arachnids deep in the woods.  I can't exactly pinpoint where their webs are, but I'm sure you'll figure it out once you're stuck in them.  I'd like me a spider egg!
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, make sure you're ready for whatever beast is waiting for you.
dialogue.rejected: That's all right.  Not everyone is cut out for this.
dialogue.advice: Don't worry <name_g>, I wouldn't send you on a suicide mission, would I?
dialogue.success: Nice catch!  Friend, you've proven yourself to be an extraordinary survivor.  Maybe there's still hope for humanity.  I'll take that egg, thank you very much.  Here's your reward and some bullets for your effort.
dialogue.success_lie: You liar!
dialogue.failure: You give up?  This country fell apart because no one could find a good man to rely on… might as well give up, I guess.

MISSION_GODCO_RUSSELL_TROPHY3.name: Trophy Hunt III
MISSION_GODCO_RUSSELL_TROPHY3.description: Bring one last trophy to Russell Connelly.  Harvest a sting from a bee.

dialogue.offer: It feels like I'm doing this for revenge.  I have one last mission for you.  Ever seen those ginormous bee hives?  Well, I can tell you where the closest one is.  Just kill off one stray bee, harvest its stinger and bring it to me.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may God guide your path.
dialogue.rejected: This passion of mine may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: If I were you, I'd bring a gun and a butcher knife.  I don't think bug spray work anymore.
dialogue.inquire: How is the hunt going, survivor?  Any luck?
dialogue.success: Well, partner, this might just be the end of the road.  I hope you enjoyed it as much as I have.  In the meantime… here's your reward, a handful of icons, that's all I have left.  Spend them all, I think you've deserved it.
dialogue.success_lie: You liar!
dialogue.failure: You give up now?  This country fell apart because no one could find a good man to rely on… might as well give up, I guess.

MISSION_GODCO_ZACHARY_KILL_NIGHTMARE.name: End The Nightmare
MISSION_GODCO_ZACHARY_KILL_NIGHTMARE.description: Kill whatever's keeping Zachary up at night.

dialogue.describe: Kill whatever's keeping Zachary up at night.
dialogue.success: Oh thank you!  Now I can finally get a nights sleep.  Here, I've got some icons saved up, I want you to have them.
dialogue.success_lie: I can still hear it, crying out in the night.
dialogue.failure: I'm not gonna go and fix this <freaking> mess.

MISSION_GODCO_GREENWOOD_1.name: Fungus Among Us
MISSION_GODCO_GREENWOOD_1.description: Purge the cultists in exchange for <reward_count:icon> icons.

dialogue.offer: There's a weird fungus that started to invade ever since <the_cataclysm>, and several individuals in strange robes are cultivating it.  I've seen what it can do, so I need you to execute them and destroy all traces of these strange mushrooms.
dialogue.accepted: God bless you!
dialogue.rejected: That fungus is going to kill us all if it isn't stopped.
dialogue.advice: Despite how fast it grows, it's highly vulnerable to fire.
dialogue.success: Thank you.  I don't like killing people, but this time we had to.  Here, take this; its some of our internal money that we've started using.  You know those religious pamphlets shaped like bills people would leave?  These are some of those, couldn't stand 'em myself.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: We'll have to try again, I suppose.

MISSION_GODCO_GREENWOOD_2.name: Relic Recovery
MISSION_GODCO_GREENWOOD_2.description: Retrieve a religious relic for Greenwood in exchange for <reward_count:icon> icons.

dialogue.offer: I've been looking to spruce up this place with some iconography, and a small relic would do just that.  It'd help tremendously with morale around here, so I need you to find one for me.
dialogue.accepted: Please bring it back as soon as possible.
dialogue.rejected: It'd really help us…
dialogue.advice: I know most cathedrals keep small relics, that's a good place to look.
dialogue.success: Thank you, <name_g>.  Take these for your trouble.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I'll have to make my own, I guess…

MISSION_GODCO_GREENWOOD_3.name: Bible Belt
MISSION_GODCO_GREENWOOD_3.description: Find twenty King James Bibles for Greenwood in exchange for <reward_count:icon> icons.

dialogue.offer: When we skipped town during <the_cataclysm>, most of us left our possessions behind.  We only have a few Bibles here for all of us, and they're starting to fall apart.  If you could get 20 more, in the King James version, I'd pay well for them.
dialogue.accepted: May God bless you.
dialogue.rejected: It'd really help us…
dialogue.advice: A book store should have enough, I'll mark one for you.
dialogue.success: May God bless you, <name_g>.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I'll have to make my own, I guess…

MISSION_GODCO_JULIAN_PAPER.name: Remnants of Civilization
MISSION_GODCO_JULIAN_PAPER.description: Find ten rolls of toilet paper for Julian Ray.

dialogue.describe: I have a job for you…
dialogue.offer: As a matter of fact, yes you can.  You see, we're running low on toilet paper.  It's not something we can't live without, but it's luxury we can afford.  I can pay you handsomely if you find us ten rolls of toilet paper.
dialogue.accepted: Well, that's great.  Good luck.
dialogue.rejected: Changed your mind already?
dialogue.advice: You remember what toilet paper is, right?
dialogue.inquire: How's the search going?  Any luck?
dialogue.success: Thank you.  Maybe you people aren't so bad after all.
dialogue.success_lie: Could you give it to me then?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_GODCO_JULIAN_RINGS.name: The Honeymooners
MISSION_GODCO_JULIAN_RINGS.description: Get two wedding rings for Julian.

dialogue.offer: Olwen and I have been dating for a while now, and I was planning on asking her to marry me.  I never got the chance to buy our rings before <the_cataclysm>, but I think I'll surprise her with some in a few days.  If you could get me two of them, I'll pay a fair price: $50 in icons.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks <name_g>, I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: I'd mean so much to the both of us, and there's a lot of money involved.
dialogue.advice: A jewelry store should have a pair.  If not, I'd check a wedding venue.
dialogue.success: Here's the money, as per our terms.  I really do appreciate this.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: I'll have to look for them myself…

MISSION_GODCO_JULIAN_DRESS.name: The Wedding
MISSION_GODCO_JULIAN_DRESS.description: Get a wedding dress for Julian's wedding with Olwen.

dialogue.offer: Olwen said yes!  I can't thank you enough <name_g>, she was delighted.  I now want to give her a proper wedding like the ones before <the_cataclysm>, but I can't find a good enough dress for her in here.  If you could get me a proper wedding dress, I'll reward you handsomely.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks <name_g>, I knew I could count on you.
dialogue.rejected: Please!  I only want to give her a beautiful day like she deserves, and if you help me I can pay you like before.
dialogue.advice: A mall should have some in exhibition.  If not, I'd check a wedding venue or clothing store.
dialogue.success: It's beautiful!  Thank you, she will love it, You are definitely invited to the wedding <name_g>!  I hope to see you there!
dialogue.success_lie: Why would you do this?!
dialogue.failure: Well, thanks for trying…

dialogue.offer: To be honest, I'm not alright.  Have you met Darryl?  He's my husband, and we had a go at getting a baby recently.  The thing is, its not happening.  Now that we're in a safe spot, on our feet again, I want to try.  I'm trying to find some fertility supplements.  I ordered some before <the_cataclysm>, but I never got to pick them up.  If you'd go over and get them for me, I'd pay you.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: This means so much to me.
dialogue.advice: They should be near the counter, or on a shelf.
dialogue.success: Oh thank you!  Darryl will be so happy to hear about this!  Take there for your payment, it must've been hard for you.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: How unfortunate…

MISSION_GODCO_GEMMA_SEEDS.name: Find cactus seeds
MISSION_GODCO_GEMMA_SEEDS.description: Find ten cactus seeds for Gemma.

dialogue.offer: I'm wanting to try growing some new plants.  I've never tried growing cactus; if you could find some seeds for me, I'd pay you.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: I suppose more local fauna could work.
dialogue.advice: I'd try a gardening store or a home supply store would have some.
dialogue.inquire: Have you found any cactus seeds?
dialogue.success: I appreciate that, here's your money.  Parts of the cactus, such as the fruit, are edible.  I'll have to ask Simon if he can experiment with some of them.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: How unfortunate…

dialogue.offer: I'm running out of antipsychotics, and Arturo is starting to see things again.  I'd pay for seventy-five antipsychotic pills, and be eternally grateful.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  Arturo will be happy to get these.
dialogue.rejected: Would you please reconsider?  Arturo's had some bad hallucinations before, he'll go crazy without them.
dialogue.advice: The storage room of a pharmacy should have them.
dialogue.success: God bless you, <name_g>.  Arturo shouldn't have to worry about his hallucinations for a long time.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: How unfortunate…

MISSION_GODCO_CORRIE_MACHINE1.name: Renewable Energy
MISSION_GODCO_CORRIE_MACHINE1.description: Find a solar panel array or 4 solar panels of either regular or advanced variant for Corrie.

dialogue.offer: Okay, great.  We're gonna create a charger and a generator all in one.  Here's the battle plan.  Zack could create the framework, you'll get me a solar panel, the rest I can craft or repurpose from the bus.  Helena's promised us a reward if this thing lives up to her standards.
dialogue.accepted: With my brains and your brawn we'll make an excellent team.  A regular solar panel will do just fine.
dialogue.rejected: No electricity for us then.
dialogue.advice: All you need is a good wrench and a solar car.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the solar panel?
dialogue.success: The great work is now complete.  Are you good with words, by the way?  I was thinking, maybe you should be the one to negotiate with Helena.  But whatever you do, don't accept their icons.  Our work is worth a lot more than their valueless currency.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: No electricity for us then.

MISSION_GODCO_FELICITY_1.name: Writers' Will
MISSION_GODCO_FELICITY_1.description: Get 800 sheets of paper for Felicity Powell.

dialogue.offer: Since <the_cataclysm> happened, I've had a surprising amount of free time.  I want to start writing, but there's very little paper around here.  For the time being, eight hundred sheets should do; I'll pay if you can get it for me.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, you'll be the first to see my writing.
dialogue.rejected: I can understand that.  The offer's still available if you reconsider.
dialogue.advice: A bookstore or office supply should have tons of it.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.  I'll get to work on my manuscript.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: How unfortunate…

dialogue.offer: I've been writing for a bit, and I've used up my pencils.  If you could get me thirty more, I'll give you some money.
dialogue.accepted: I do appreciate it.
dialogue.rejected: I can understand that.  The offer's still available if you reconsider.
dialogue.advice: An office building should have tons.
dialogue.success: Thank you so much!  I'll get back to work on my manuscript, I should have it ready in a month or so.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: How unfortunate…

MISSION_GODCO_THERESA_1.name: Get some oxycodone
MISSION_GODCO_THERESA_1.description: Find seven oxycodone pills for Theresa.

dialogue.offer: I've got an idea to solve my problem.  I'll pay you if you can find seven oxycodone pills for me; the ones they used to prescribe after a surgery.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, <granny_name_g>.  I'm glad the youngsters still help the elderly.
dialogue.rejected: I can understand your hesitation <granny_name_g>.  I wouldn't worry about it too much.
dialogue.advice: An old doctors office should have some.  They have those fancy autodocs upstairs.
dialogue.success: I want you to have these few things of mine, I won't be needing them anymore.  I think I'll take a walk in the woods, get some fresh air for these old bones…
dialogue.success_lie: Deceitful rogue, you…
dialogue.failure: How unfortunate…

dialogue.offer: Have you met Chloe?  She's the girl with the butcher knife, came here with Sonia.  This may sound silly, but I want to ask her out on a date, have a picnic some time.  The only thing I need to get this plan to come together is a candle.  If you happen to find one, I'll pay you for it.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, <name_g>.
dialogue.rejected: Please?  The dating scene isn't that big around here.
dialogue.advice: Someone's house might have one.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_KATHERINE_1.name: Fishy Business
MISSION_GODCO_KATHERINE_1.description: Find three cans of sardines, tuna, or salmon for Katherine.

dialogue.offer: I've had a craving for fish recently.  Could you find three cans of tuna for me?  I'll pay you for them.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: Alright.  I'll do it myself.
dialogue.advice: A house or grocery store should have some.
dialogue.success: Thank you, here's your payment.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_KOSTAS_1.name: Natural Chemistry
MISSION_GODCO_KOSTAS_1.description: Get a chemistry set for Kostas.

dialogue.offer: I've decided to start making more concentrated remedies for more serious cases, but I don't have a way of refining any herbs to that degree.  I'd pay for a chemistry set.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, <name_g>.
dialogue.rejected: We could all use the medicine, including you.
dialogue.advice: A laboratory or pharmaceutical factory should have one.
dialogue.inquire: Have you found the chemistry set?
dialogue.success: Blessings be unto you.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_KOSTAS_2.name: Pebble Pusher
MISSION_GODCO_KOSTAS_2.description: Get 814 pounds of pebbles (5,600 pebbles) for Kostas.

dialogue.offer: Demand for my herbal medicine has gone up recently, and I'm struggling to get all of my ingredients sustainably.  I'm going to build some planters on the rooftop, but I lack the material to do so in full.  I'd compensate you fairly for 814 pounds of pebbles.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, <name_g>.
dialogue.rejected: I understand that it seems formidable, but there is a good deal of money for you.
dialogue.advice: An outdoor emporium should have some.  Of course, you could always dig them up from a lakeshore or driveway.
dialogue.success: Blessings be unto you.  I'll start on the garden right away.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_KOSTAS_3.name: Out Of This World Cures
MISSION_GODCO_KOSTAS_3.description: Find a Marloss berry for Kostas.

dialogue.offer: I'm wanting to experiment with some of the more…  otherworldly fauna that have appeared recently.  I saw these pink berries inside a fungal infestation the other day before I burned it with a Molotov.  If you could get me one, I can pay you with a discount on my medicine.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, <name_g>.
dialogue.rejected: I understand that it seems formidable, but there is a good deal of money for you.
dialogue.advice: I'd wear a hazmat suit while I'm in there.  Those spores are absolutely nasty for your health, if my observations of <zombies> nearby are any indication.
dialogue.success: I'll have to be careful with this thing, thanks for getting it for me.  Let's see what this can do…
dialogue.success_lie: Did you eat the thing?  Please tell me your joking.
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_TOM_1.name: Digital Revolution
MISSION_GODCO_TOM_1.description: Get a e-ink tablet PC for Tom Powell.

dialogue.offer: I've assembled quite a collection of evidence in my research, and I want an easier way to organize it.  If you could get me one of those e-ink tablets, I could scan all my documents into an easily-preserved digital format.  There's some money for you, too.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, <name_g>.  The truth is ever closer!
dialogue.rejected: Don't you want to know the truth behind <the_cataclysm>?
dialogue.advice: I'd check an electronics store for one.
dialogue.success: Here's the money I promised you.  I'll start organizing my collection.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_TOM_2.name: Missing Persons
MISSION_GODCO_TOM_2.description: Find 25 missing person posters for Tom Powell.

dialogue.offer: I want to take a look at some of the missing posters for any links.  If you could get me twenty-five of them, I could start my analysis.  Make sure to get posters for adults, I don't think any children could provide links.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, <name_g>.  The truth is ever closer!
dialogue.rejected: Don't you want to know the truth behind <the_cataclysm>?
dialogue.advice: There should be plenty on poster-boards around town.  A police station should have a lot.
dialogue.success: I wonder what the link could be.  Too much information?  Government conspiracy?  Aliens?  I'll have to find out.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

dialogue.offer: I've decided to broaden my horizons with my research, now I need more general documents for examination, get the big picture.  If you could get me two hundred files, on anything, I'll pay you for them.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, <name_g>.  The truth is ever closer!
dialogue.rejected: Don't you want to know the truth behind <the_cataclysm>?
dialogue.advice: Office buildings, police stations, any high-profile place should have what we want.
dialogue.success: This should occupy my work for a while.  Thanks <name_g>, we'll discover the truth one of these days.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_OLWEN_1.name: Mathematical Measures
MISSION_GODCO_OLWEN_1.description: Find some MatheMAX for Olwen Powell.

dialogue.offer: I've started working on a small project of mine which requires a great deal of computational input.  A piece of MatheMAX software would be a great help.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: Doing this many calculations by hand isn't very fun, you know.
dialogue.advice: I'd check one of the local schools for a USB stick with it.
dialogue.success: This'll be quite useful in the future.  Thank you, <name_g>.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_OLWEN_2.name: Radio-active
MISSION_GODCO_OLWEN_2.description: Get six antennae for Olwen Powell.

dialogue.offer: Corrie and I have been working on a way to get in touch with anyone who's still out there, and we've started rigging up an internet-to-radio broadcast.  The only thing we need are antennae, six of them specifically.
dialogue.accepted: This could give us a prosperous future, <name_g>.
dialogue.rejected: We've got to see how many people are out there.
dialogue.advice: A radio tower should have some lying around in storage.
dialogue.success: Now we can get in touch with a lot more people, see what's out there.  Thank you, <name_g>.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_MARIA_1.name: Cotton Conundrum
MISSION_GODCO_MARIA_1.description: Find 300 cotton patches for Maria Serrano.

dialogue.offer: I'm starting to run low on cotton for my sewing.  I think three hundred cotton patches should hold me for a while; I'll pay you for them if you get me some.
dialogue.accepted: Great stuff!
dialogue.rejected: How am I supposed to tailor if I have nothing to tailor with?
dialogue.advice: You could try cutting up some unneeded sweaters from a clothing store, or you could make some yourself.
dialogue.success: Thank you, <name_g>.  This should do me for a while.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

MISSION_GODCO_MARIA_2.name: Spinning Wheels
MISSION_GODCO_MARIA_2.description: Find an electric spinning wheel for Maria Serrano.

dialogue.offer: I want to try making my own cloth, it's getting harder to find the quantities I need.  I'll buy an electric spinning wheel if you can find one, it'd vastly expedite the process.
dialogue.accepted: Great stuff!
dialogue.rejected: It'd really help me in getting your stuff to you faster.
dialogue.advice: A textile museum should have one lying around.
dialogue.inquire: Have you found the spinning wheel?
dialogue.success: This is wonderful!  I'll really be able to put the pedal to the metal!
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: That's too bad…

dialogue.offer: We were in the process of refurbishing the retreat when <the_cataclysm> interrupted us.  Some of the plumbing around here was troublesome, and we need to fix that.  200 pipes should be all we need to finish it.
dialogue.accepted: May God protect you.
dialogue.rejected: I'll find someone else, then.
dialogue.advice: A public works or a craft shop should have some lying around.  If not, try a steel mill.
dialogue.success: Thank you.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: As expected of such a person…

MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_2.name: Planning Planers
MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_2.description: Find two planers for Helena Misinter.

dialogue.offer: I'm looking to construct some fortifications around the church, should any of Satan's devils decide to run amok.  We have most of the material needed for such an undertaking, but processing our raw lumber is taking far too long.  I've heard a planer could do such in a fraction of the time; I'll pay for two of them.
dialogue.accepted: May God protect you.
dialogue.rejected: I'll find someone else, then.
dialogue.advice: I'd poke around any industrial sites for some.
dialogue.success: Thank you.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: As expected of such a person…

MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_3.name: Purging Heresy
MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_3.description: Kill some bandits for Helena Misinter.

dialogue.offer: Blasphemy, heresy, the righteous judgment of God!  I have found the scum of Hell pillaging a church for valuables!  Even in <the_cataclysm>, I shall not stand for this.  I want you to go there and wipe those <freaking> <name_b>s from the Earth.
dialogue.accepted: Righteous judgment shall come!
dialogue.rejected: Are you standing with them?
dialogue.advice: Attack at night to surprise them.  Barring that, go in full force, guns blazing.  I wouldn't try to call a horde in, I don't want to ruin such a holy place.
dialogue.success: Thank you.
dialogue.success_lie: Why have you failed us?!
dialogue.failure: As expected of such a person…

MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_4.name: Preservation of Sustenance
MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_4.description: Find five canning pots for Helena Misinter.

dialogue.offer: While we are blessed with a bountiful stock, we need a way to preserve our newer food, mainly those potatoes Darryl's growing.  Fortunately, he brought a book on canning things.  We need five canning pots to get the setup going in full fashion.
dialogue.accepted: May the Lord bless you.
dialogue.rejected: I'll find someone else, then.
dialogue.advice: An old factory might have one, or a hobby shop.
dialogue.inquire: Have you found the canning pots?
dialogue.success: Thank you.  You're welcome to some of our first batch, if you're interested.
dialogue.success_lie: What good is this?
dialogue.failure: As expected of such a person…

MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_VISIT_MERCHANTS.name: Investigate the Center
MISSION_GODCO_HELENA_VISIT_MERCHANTS.description: Go to the location Helena told you about and see who's there.

dialogue.success: This should be very useful to us.  Now we can truly begin our march of righteousness.
dialogue.failure: As expected of such a person…

MISSION_INVESTIGATE_TRADER.name: Investigate the Trader
MISSION_INVESTIGATE_TRADER.description: Find some proof that the representative near the New England Community Church is crooked.

dialogue.describe: Find some proof about that merchant.
dialogue.success: Thanks, we'll take the needed initiative.
dialogue.failure: Of course, you have no evidence.

dialogue.offer: I need to build fences and ditches around my rabbits.  Could you find about… five logs for me?
dialogue.accepted: Don't forget to tell me when you have them.
dialogue.rejected: It's okay, I can do without them.  Just let me know if you reconsider.
dialogue.advice: There's a lot of places to look.  Trees are pretty common.
dialogue.inquire: How is the search going?  Have you found 'em?
dialogue.success: I really appreciate your help.  Don't worry, you won't leave empty-handed.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: Don't worry about it, it's not that important.

dialogue.offer: Fruits would let me break the monotony of grains and meats.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks for accepting this task.  Otherwise I might kill a stranger for some oranges.  Just kidding.
dialogue.rejected: Just let me know if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: Find someone growing berries or an orchard.
dialogue.success: Thank you for your help.  Here's your reward.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: It's not a big deal, it isn't that urgent.

MISSION_Warrener_ISHERWOOD.name: Visit the Isherwoods
MISSION_Warrener_ISHERWOOD.description: There is a family nearby that I'd like you to check in on.  After you talk to all of them, come back to me and tell me how they are doing.

dialogue.success: Good, that's one less thing to worry about.
dialogue.success_lie: I'm glad to hear they are fine.  Why haven't they been by then?
dialogue.failure: At least you came back with your life…

dialogue.describe: Well, now that you mention it…
dialogue.offer: You see, some time ago, I ran into this guy who offered me a substantial payment in exchange for a Remington 870 Express.  I asked if he'd like another weapon, since nowadays, any gun will do, but for some reason, he's dead set on that particular model.  If you could obtain one for me, well, I'd be quite grateful.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Let me know when you get it, and I'll try to get in touch with him.
dialogue.rejected: Suit yourself.  Ain't a rush.
dialogue.advice: Well, a gun store is a solid bet, but the model is common enough.  Maybe you can find one in a police station, or a store with hunting gear.
dialogue.success: Fantastic!  I'll try and get it to the buyer, if he's still alive.  If not, well, still a good gun to sell.  Now, how would you like to be compensated?
dialogue.success_lie: How did you even get this option to display the hell.
dialogue.failure: Then where is it?

dialogue.describe: I need an anvil to do advanced metal work.
dialogue.offer: I could really use an anvil.
dialogue.accepted: You might be able to find one in a hardware store or similar.
dialogue.rejected: Thanks anyway, we'll find the time to make it ourselves.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find one, maybe you can make one for me.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, this will really make a difference, here's some horse armor I've been working on.  Eventually I'll have the whole herd outfitted.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do me?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: Chris hasn't come back from his latest search for Barry, I'm getting concerned.
dialogue.offer: Can you go find my son and tell him to check in with us.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I hope he turns up soon.
dialogue.advice: He might be on the property somewhere, maybe by that old cabin near the entrance, sometimes he camps there.
dialogue.success: Thanks, I was getting ready to go look myself.  Now that I have the anvil, I've been working on new armor for the horses, take this prototype I made.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I hope he didn't meet Barry's fate…

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CHRIS_1.name: Free Barry from the mysterious structure
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CHRIS_1.name_plural: Free Barry from the mysterious structures

dialogue.describe: We need to investigate the alien encampment and try to find out what happened to Barry.
dialogue.offer: I can take you to the structure, I tracked them to it.
dialogue.accepted: Awesome, I want some answers!
dialogue.rejected: Thanks anyway, I'll keep my eye on it, maybe I'll find a way one day.
dialogue.advice: I feel like we are underprepared if they see us, I marked the location for you.
dialogue.success: It's taller then I remember, we should look for prisoners.  I left a note for my family before we left.  If we survive, the cabin should be fixed up and ready for you to move in if you want to stay.
dialogue.success_lie: Well it was here…
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CHRIS_1_GET_GEAR.name: Retrieve 5 sets of riot armor for the Isherwoods
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_CHRIS_1_GET_GEAR.name_plural: Retrieve 5 sets of riot armor for the Isherwoodss

dialogue.describe: I could use some help foraging ingredients.
dialogue.offer: I could use some fresh dandelions for the next batch of wine.  Can you bring me 50 dandelions?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, I'll put these to good use.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Maybe some other time, thanks.

dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?

dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  It's important to have a good stock before the flu season hits.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Maybe some other time, thanks.
dialogue.advice: You should search through the forest, make sure to check in the underbrush for bee balm and then harvest its seeds.

dialogue.accepted: Thank you!  Please hurry back!  Take this cage so you have a chance of capturing one.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't want to use chemicals on these rats.
dialogue.advice: Take this pet carrier; if you can get close to a cat, you can put it inside.  If you're having problems, try befriending it with cat food.

dialogue.rejected: Thanks anyway, we'll find the time to get them ourselves.
dialogue.advice: Mining would always be an option if you had the resources.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it, this will make Luke happy.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.advice: A gun will probably help.

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_LUKE_1.name: Find The Art of Glassblowing book
MISSION_ISHERWOOD_LUKE_1.name_plural: Find The Art of Glassblowing books

MISSION_ISHERWOOD_LUKE_2.name_plural: Find a copy of DIY Compendiums

MISSION_LUKE_RETRIEVE_TRUCK.description: Kill the two bandits for Luke Isherwood to get their truck.

MISSION_LUKE_RETRIEVE_TRUCK_EXPLOSIVES.name: Retrieve Some Dynamite for Luke
MISSION_LUKE_RETRIEVE_TRUCK_EXPLOSIVES.description: Get 50 pounds of dynamite for Luke Isherwood to make a bomb.  There's a known shipment at a mine in the region.

MISSION_PRISONER_LEADER_GET_ID_CARD.name: Get The Thing from the chief's office
MISSION_PRISONER_LEADER_GET_ID_CARD.name_plural: Get The Thing from the chief's offices

dialogue.offer: My snitch whispered in my ear that the thing I need is located in the chief's safe in his office.  You need to crack it open and bring the contents to me.  Don't try to use anything you find in there!  Just bring all the stuff to me, and I'll help you.  Deal?
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Don't forget that I need all stuff from the safe, try not to lose a thing.
dialogue.rejected: Fine, I'll get the thing in any case, sooner or later.
dialogue.advice: The chief's office is on the other side of the prison.  I think the road there is full of <zombies>, so you better find a weapon.  Also you probably will need some tools to crack the safe open.
dialogue.inquire: Did you get the stuff already?
dialogue.success: At last!  Give me a few moments to check if it isn't damaged.  Here, take this for your troubles.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This isn't going to work like I thought.
dialogue.failure: You're useless.  I should've killed you when I met you.

MISSION_BLACKSMITH_1.name: Find the gun
MISSION_BLACKSMITH_1.description: Cody wants you to go to a gun show and find a rare gun that Jay wanted to see.  It was an AK of some kind with a weird name… something like CARD or CORE.

dialogue.offer: Before everything went to hell Jay was talking about going to some gun show.  There was a guy there who had managed to sneak some Russian gun into the US.  It was a massive deal for Jay, it was all he could talk about.  I know it's a long shot but maybe that guy was already at the gun show?  If you find the gun you can keep it, but it would mean a lot to Jay if he could take a look all he wanted was to pull it apart and put it back together.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks.  I'll start working on an apology.
dialogue.rejected: Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: I'd be careful there; Jay was saying they were bringing some new autonomous hardware to the show.  You're looking for a Russian rifle that should be modded to the moon.  CARD, CORE rifle, something like that.
dialogue.inquire: Any luck finding that gun show?  I think it was a Russian gun, maybe a CARD or CORE rifle?  Something like that.
dialogue.success: Thanks, darlin'.  If you could show it to Jay, that would mean a lot to me.  If there's anything I could ever make for you as payment after that, just let me know.
dialogue.success_lie: That's great!  Make sure to show it to Jay.
dialogue.failure: Well you tried at least…

MISSION_GUNSMITH_1.name: Find the debug software
MISSION_GUNSMITH_1.description: Jay wants you to go to someone's house and get some software that they had taken home.

dialogue.offer: Alright, so Cody has talked about some cutting-edge tech she's seen displayed.  This thing is called a nano-fabricator.  It's like a complicated, robotic 3D printer.  Cody used to run with some hackers that steal IP, schematics, that sort of thing.  I guess a problem they were running into was the newest tech stuff is all encrypted as templates for these printers.  Well, I know of a colleague who went home with debug software for the system.  You get that for her, and we're in business.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks.  I'll start working on an apology.
dialogue.rejected: Let me know if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: I'd be careful.  Guy was a bit of a nut, I don't know what he was planning to do with that software.
dialogue.success: Thanks bud, I'll take it from here.  Take care of that rifle, now.
dialogue.success_lie: Shame.  Shame, shame.
dialogue.failure: Well fuck me then.

MISSION_SEER_GATHER_BONE.name: Find 8 bones
MISSION_SEER_GATHER_BONE.description: Brigitte LaCroix asked you to collect clean, untainted bones in order to better understand her beliefs.  8 bones should be sufficient.

dialogue.describe: There is always work to be done, song to be woven.
dialogue.offer: If you wish to be set on the path to enlightenment, first you must learn to listen and hear the song.  Go out, butcher an untainted creature and feel the power between your fingertips.  Then bring me the bones and I shall carve them for you.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent.  Now be on your way.
dialogue.rejected: I understand your reluctance.  Feel free to return when you see the way.
dialogue.advice: The shambling corpses we see all around move in discord.  Their song can be used, but for an Acolyte, this would be needlessly hard.  Be sure to carve an unspoiled living creature.
dialogue.inquire: Have you felt the song in your hands yet?
dialogue.success: And so, another cycle ends.  You have done well.  I will now bestow my mark upon you, so that others may know the path you walk and aid you.
dialogue.success_lie: So you say, but the song sings otherwise.
dialogue.failure: Then you shall try again, until you hear.

MISSION_lighthouse_girl_0.name: Protect fisherman's daughter
MISSION_lighthouse_girl_0.description: She looks like a nice girl.  Maybe you should not let her die?

dialogue.offer: We've been wandering around the state with my family for a long time since <the_cataclysm>, and I realized that the safest hideout is the island.  I left my family in a shelter, and went to explore the area, looking for some island nearby, in a lake or in the ocean.  And you know, I found a sea map marked with navigational beacons near here.  If you want, you can help me get to one of these and take a good look at it.
dialogue.accepted: Good.  I'll be right behind you.
dialogue.rejected: Well, it's your choice.
dialogue.advice: First we need to find a transport to get there.
dialogue.success: Looks nice, <name_g>.  Now I need to clean it from <zombies> somehow…

dialogue.offer: So, we found the lighthouse.  Now, I need to clean it.  Want to help me with it?
dialogue.accepted: Great.  Let's do it together.  I'll be right behind you.  We will clean floor by floor.  If you decide that the floor is clean, tell me about it, and we will move on to the next, and so on to the very top.
dialogue.rejected: Well, it's your choice.
dialogue.advice: Be careful.  These <name_b>s are most dangerous in tight spaces.
dialogue.success: Great, incredibly great.  All that remains is to wash all the floors…

MISSION_lighthouse_man_3.name: Fisherman's family
MISSION_lighthouse_man_3.description: Mikhail asked you to bring back his family.

dialogue.offer: We found the lighthouse and cleared it of <zombies>.  Now, I need to bring my family here.  May I ask you for a favor?  Since you bring me here, can you go back, find my family and bring them here?
dialogue.accepted: You are my savior!  I'll take a look around here for a while, prepare everything here for their arrival.
dialogue.rejected: Well, it's your choice.
dialogue.advice: Please be very careful.  I don't want to lose them…
dialogue.success: I don't even know how to thank you, <name_g>.  I am in eternal debt to you.

MISSION_lighthouse_man_4.name: Fisherman's boat
MISSION_lighthouse_man_4.description: Help Mikhail make a boat.  Bring 250 nails.

dialogue.offer: The building has been cleared of <zombies>, my family is here, everything is going very well.  It remains only to provide ourselves with food, transport and we can not worry about the future.  You helped me and my family so much, can you help us with something else?  I need a boat for fishing, or just to explore the area.  Can you help me make a boat?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, <name_g>.  I need only 250 nails.  I'll find the planks, the rest of the tools too, but the main problem is the nails.  Too much for one boat, but I want to have resources in reserve, just in case.
dialogue.rejected: Well, it's your choice.
dialogue.advice: Please, if you can, don't disassemble furniture here.  It can still be useful.
dialogue.success: Very good, <name_g>, thank you!  Now we are not afraid of hunger, rain, or other bad weather, he-he.  By the way, I have a small supply of fish, tackle, baits and rods.  If you are interested, I can share some with you.

MISSION_lighthouse_man_5.name: Fixing lighthouse
MISSION_lighthouse_man_5.description: Mikhail asked you to find someone, who have enough expertise to fix the mechanism of lighthouse.

dialogue.offer: My family is here, we have food, water, boat and a roof over our heads, all thanks to you, <name_g>.  Now, I also want to help other survivors.  Here's what I thought: if I can get this old lighthouse up and running, other survivors will see its light from afar.  If they see it, they will think that there are living people here, and will try to get here.  Can you help me fix it?
dialogue.accepted: I knew you wouldn't refuse!  But there is one problem: I have no idea how to fix it.  Maybe if you met someone who have experience in electrical engineering, we can figure out how to start this old junk.
dialogue.rejected: Well, it's your choice.
dialogue.advice: I'm sure that not all burned in flames of <the_cataclysm> and you can find someone suitable.
dialogue.success: Splendid, <name_g>!  We can only wait now…

MISSION_lighthouse_woman_0.name: Protect fisherman's wife
MISSION_lighthouse_woman_0.description: She looks like a nice woman.  Maybe you should not let her die?

MISSION_GET_DRIVEBELTS.name: Find Drive Belts
MISSION_GET_DRIVEBELTS.description: Obtain 3 drive belts in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Some of our machinery received some damage before <the_cataclysm> and we were waiting on replacement parts.  Now everything's changed and those parts are more important than ever.  Get us three drive belts and I'll give you some credit with us.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find actual drive belts on engines, a good replacement can be made from a belt and some duct tape.  Nothing difficult.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  Thanks, <name_g>, we'll be fine for a long while from now.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_1000_NAILS.name: Get 1,000 Nails
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_1000_NAILS.description: Obtain 1,000 nails in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Along with those drive belts, we were waiting for some nails for structural repairs.  Due to <the_cataclysm>, we obviously never received them.  So, I need you to get us 1,000 nails.  We'll pay you fairly.
dialogue.advice: Taking apart some furniture in town should get what you need.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Our warehouse was about to fall apart.  These will be extremely helpful to us.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6800_NAILS.name: Get 6,800 Nails
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6800_NAILS.description: Obtain 6,800 nails in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: While fairly sturdy, the metal fence around this place won't hold out for long.  So, we've decided to replace it with a wall.  However, the nails we had were used to repair our existing structures, and they weren't nearly enough.  After some calculations, we need 6,800 nails to do it.  That may seem like a lot, but we're willing to give you a TON of credit for it.
dialogue.advice: You might have to do more than just scrapping a bunch of furniture.  Dismantling a building somewhere in town could get you what you need.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, I suppose that's reasonable.
dialogue.success: That's absolutely amazing!  I can't thank you enough for this!
dialogue.success_lie: You're a fucking scammer, <name_b>!
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6_BLANKETS.name: Find 6 Blankets
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_GET_6_BLANKETS.description: Obtain 6 blankets or quilts in exchange for credit with the loggers.

dialogue.offer: Now that we should be safe from harm, I decided to start adding a few things to this place.  Right now, we don't have anywhere to comfortably sleep, so we're building a small sleeping quarter.  We just need 6 big, warm blankets or quilts to finish our project.
dialogue.advice: I figure any hotel or motel in town should have lots of blankets.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Well, someone's got to do it.
dialogue.inquire: Did you find us some bedding yet?
dialogue.success: Thanks!  Feel free to sleep here if you want.  It's the least we can do for the help.
dialogue.success_lie: How is this supposed to help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to do it.

MISSION_LUMBERMILL_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.name: Establish A Trade Route
MISSION_LUMBERMILL_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.description: Establish trade relations between the loggers and a refugee center, and bring back a writ of the agreement.

dialogue.offer: While some of us were out scavenging, we spotted an old evac shelter that looks like it might have some people inside.  I want you to go over there, find whoever runs the joint, and see if we can make a deal with them for some processed lumber.  This will be invaluable to our survival.
dialogue.advice: It should be pretty simple making the deal, but I'd recommend taking a car over there myself.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
