dialogue.rejected: Please give it a try?  This is really important to us.
dialogue.inquire: What did they say about the deal?
dialogue.success: Thank you!  We're set for life on this one!
dialogue.success_lie: How does this help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to trade with.

dialogue.describe: You wouldn't believe what I found…
dialogue.offer: Holy hell, the crash you recovered the black box from wasn't as old as I thought.  Check this out, it was on its approach to pick up a team sent to secure and destroy something called a 'Hazardous Waste Sarcophagus' in the middle of nowhere.  If the bird never picked up the team then we may still have a chance to meet up with them.  It includes an access code for the elevator and an encoded message for the team leader, I guess.  If we want to join up with what remains of the government then now may be our only chance.
dialogue.accepted: Fuck ya, America!
dialogue.rejected: Are you going to forfeit your duty when the country needs you the most?
dialogue.advice: If there is a military team down there then we better go in prepared if we want to impress them.  Carry as much ammo as you can and prepare to ditch this place if they have a second bird coming to pick them up.
dialogue.inquire: Having any trouble following the map?  Remember to search underground.
dialogue.success: Maybe these things are what remains of the team we were searching for…
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  I oughta whip your ass.
dialogue.failure: Damn, we were so close.

dialogue.offer: I'm asthmatic.  I need you to get an inhaler for me…
dialogue.accepted: Oh, thank god, thank you so much!  I won't last more than a couple of days, so hurry…
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Please, I'll be dead soon without your help!
dialogue.advice: There's a town nearby.  Check pharmacies; it'll be in the back with the good stuff.
dialogue.success: Oh thank god!  I'll be right as rain in no time.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: How am I not dead already?!

dialogue.describe: This infection is bad, totally bad…
dialogue.offer: I'm infected.  Badly.  I need you to get some good antibiotics for me…
dialogue.accepted: Oh, thank god, thank you so much!  I won't last more than a couple of days, so hurry…
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Please, I'll be dead soon without your help!
dialogue.advice: There's a town nearby.  Check pharmacies; it'll be in the back, either antibiotics or broad-spectrum antibiotics will do.
dialogue.success: Oh thank god!  I'll be right as rain in no time.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: How am I not dead already?!

dialogue.describe: We've got the flag, now we need to locate US forces.
dialogue.offer: We have the flag but now we need to locate US troops to see what we can do to help.  I haven't seen any but I'm figurin' one of those choppers that were flyin' round during th' outbreak would have a good idea.  If you can get me a black box from one of the wrecks I'll look into where we might open 'er at.
dialogue.accepted: Fuck yeah, America!
dialogue.rejected: Do you have any better ideas?
dialogue.advice: Survivors were talkin' 'bout seeing 'em falling out of the sky but I don't know where.  If I were a pilot I'd avoid crash landing in a city or forest though.  Black boxes are housed in the tail to survive the crash so check there when you do find one.  Now get to it!
dialogue.success: America, fuck yeah!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  I oughta whip your ass.
dialogue.failure: Damn, I'll have to find 'er myself.

dialogue.describe: With the black box in hand, we need to find a lab.
dialogue.offer: Thanks to your searching we've got the black box but now we need to have a look inside her.  Now, most buildings don't have power anymore but there are a few that might be of use.  Have you ever seen one of those science labs that have popped up in the middle of nowhere?  Them suckers have a glowing terminal out front so I know they have power somewhere inside 'em.  If you can get inside and find a computer lab that still works you ought to be able to find out what's in the black box.
dialogue.accepted: Fuck yeah, America!
dialogue.rejected: Do you have any better ideas?
dialogue.advice: When I was playin' with the terminal for the one I ran into it kept asking for an ID card.  Finding one would be the first order of business.
dialogue.success: America, fuck yeah!  I was in the guard a few years back so I'm confident I can make heads-or-tails of these transmissions.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  I oughta whip your ass.
dialogue.failure: Damn, I maybe we can find an egg-head to crack the terminal.

dialogue.offer: I hope you will find use from what you got out of the deposit box but I also have another job for you that might lead you to an opportunity to deal out justice for those who cannot.  First things first, we can't just look like ruffians.  Find us a deputy badge, easy enough?
dialogue.accepted: I'd check the police station.
dialogue.rejected: We're also official… just hang in there and I'll show you what we can really do.
dialogue.advice: They shouldn't be that hard to find… should they?
dialogue.success: Great work, Deputy.  We're in business.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: The day of reckoning will come for the criminals if it hasn't already.

dialogue.describe: Does our flag still yet wave?
dialogue.offer: Does our flag still yet wave?  We're battered but not yet out of the fight, we need the old colors!
dialogue.accepted: Hell ya!  Find me one of those big ol' American flags.
dialogue.rejected: Seriously?  God damned commie…
dialogue.advice: Find a large federal building or school, they must have one.
dialogue.success: America, fuck ya!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You liar!
dialogue.failure: You give up?  This country fell apart because no one could find a good man to rely on… might as well give up, I guess.

dialogue.offer: Our world fell apart because our leaders were as crooked as the con-men that paid for their elections.  Just find me one of those corporate accounting books and I'll show you and the rest of the world just who is at fault.
dialogue.accepted: You'll see, I know I'm right.
dialogue.rejected: I know it isn't pressing but the big corporations didn't get a chance to destroy the evidence yet.
dialogue.advice: Try a big corporate building of some sort, they're bound to have an accounting department.
dialogue.success: Great, let's see… uh… hmmm….  Fine, I didn't even do my own taxes but I'm sure this will prove their guilt if we get an expert to examine it.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: The day of reckoning will come for the corporations if it hasn't already.

dialogue.describe: I hope I don't see many names I know…
dialogue.offer: I've lost so many friends… please find me a patient list from the regional hospital or doctor's office.  I just want to know who might still be out there.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, I suppose it won't change what has already happened but it will bring me closure.
dialogue.rejected: Please, I just want to know what happened to everyone.
dialogue.advice: I bet you'll run into a lot of those things in the hospital, please be careful.
dialogue.success: Oh dear, I thought Timmy would have made it…
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: I bet some of them are still out there…

dialogue.describe: I wonder if a retreat might exist…
dialogue.offer: Everyone who dies gets back up, right?  Which means that whatever is causing this it must be airborne to have infected everyone.  I believe that if that is the case then there should be regions that were not downwind from where-ever the disease was released.  We need to find a record of all the weather patterns leading up to the outbreak.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much, you may save both of us yet.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, it was a long shot I admit.
dialogue.advice: I'm not sure, maybe a news station would have what we are looking for?
dialogue.success: These look more complicated than I thought, just give me some time.
dialogue.success_lie: This isn't what we need.
dialogue.failure: If only we could find a great valley or something.

dialogue.describe: Any variant is fine, I am not that choosy…
dialogue.offer: The sky has torn apart and creatures beyond our wildest imaginations lurk in the dark now.  I beg you, find me a holy symbol.  Maybe some faith can help me sleep better at night.
dialogue.accepted: May whatever god or spirits that now reign the world protect you.
dialogue.rejected: I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: A church must be full of them and who knows, maybe some of those <zombies> carry some.  But please, do not waste your time making one yourself.
dialogue.inquire: Any luck?  Please find me a holy symbol.  Any of them will do.
dialogue.success: Thank the heavens.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do me?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_GET_RELIC.name: Find Relic
MISSION_GET_RELIC.description: Find a relic of a forgotten saint.  Places like <color_yellow>cathedrals</color> or <color_yellow>museums</color> might have one.

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: As the world seems to abandon the reality that we once knew, it becomes plausible that the old superstitions that were cast aside may have had some truth to them.  Please go and find me a religious relic… I doubt it will be of much use but I've got to hope in something.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: I suppose a large church or cathedral may have something.
dialogue.inquire: Any luck?  Please find me a small relic.  Any relic will do.
dialogue.success: Thank you, I need some time alone now…
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Now I don't mean to upset you but I'm not sure what I can do with the accounting ledger at the moment.  We do have a new lead though, the ledger has a safe deposit box under the regional manager's name.  Guess what, dumb sucker wrote down his combination.  Come with me to retrieve the box and you can keep any of the goodies in it that I can't use to press charges against these bastards.
dialogue.accepted: You may make a tidy profit from this.
dialogue.rejected: I know it isn't pressing but the world is going to be just as corrupt when we start rebuilding unless we take measure to stop those who seek to rule over us.
dialogue.advice: This shouldn't be hard unless we run into a horde.
dialogue.success: Great, anything I can't use to prosecute the bastards is yours, as promised.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: The day of reckoning will come for the corporations if it hasn't already.

MISSION_GET_SOFTWARE.name: Retrieve Software
MISSION_GET_SOFTWARE.description: Retrieve the software in their computer marked on your map.

dialogue.describe: Oh man, I can't believe I forgot to download it…
dialogue.offer: There's some important software on my computer that I need on USB.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks!  Just pull the data onto this USB drive and bring it to me.
dialogue.rejected: Seriously?  It's an easy job…
dialogue.advice: Take this USB drive.  Use the console, and download the software.
dialogue.inquire: So, do you have my software yet?
dialogue.success: Excellent, thank you!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You liar!
dialogue.failure: Wow, you failed?  All that work, down the drain…

dialogue.describe: It could be very informative to perform an analysis of zombie blood…
dialogue.offer: I need someone to get a sample of zombie blood, take it to a hospital, and perform a centrifuge analysis of it.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent.  Take this blood draw kit; once you've produced a zombie corpse, use it to extract blood from the body, then take it to a hospital for analysis.
dialogue.rejected: Are you sure?  The scientific value of that blood data could be priceless…
dialogue.advice: The centrifuge is a bit technical; you might want to study up on the usage of computers before completing that part.
dialogue.inquire: Well, do you have the data yet?
dialogue.success: Excellent!  This may be the key to removing the infection.
dialogue.success_lie: Wait, you couldn't possibly have the data!  Liar!
dialogue.failure: What a shame, that data could have proved invaluable…

MISSION_INVESTIGATE_CULT.name: Investigate Cult
MISSION_INVESTIGATE_CULT.description: Investigate the strange cabin in the woods and find an item that may clue you in about <color_yellow>a potential human sacrifice</color> the cult has performed, such as <color_yellow>human bones or other remains</color>.

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: You have no idea how interesting this diary is.  I have two very promising leads… first things first, the Catholic Church has been performing its own investigations into global cult phenomenon and it appears to have become very interested in a local cult as of recently.  Could you investigate a location for me?  I'm not sure what was going on here but the priest seemed fairly worried about it.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path… You may need it this time more than the past excursions you have gone on.  There is a note about potential human sacrifice in the days immediately before and after the outbreak.  The name of the cult is believed to be the Church of Starry Wisdom but it is noted that accounts differ.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: I doubt the site is still occupied but I'd carry a firearm at least… I'm not sure what you might be looking for but I'm positive you'll find something out of the ordinary if you look long enough.
dialogue.inquire: I'm positive there is something there… there has to be, any luck?
dialogue.success: Thank you, your account of these… demonic creations proves the fears the churches had were well founded.  Our priority should be routing out any survivors of this cult… I don't known if they are responsible for the outbreak but they certainly know more about it than I do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: I have another task if you are feeling up to it.  There is a prisoner that the priest made special mention of.  I was wondering if you could see what may have happened to him or if he left anything in his cell.  The priest admits the individual is rather unstable, to put it lightly, but the priest personally believed the man was some kind of repentant visionary.  I'm not in a position to cast out the account just yet… it seems the man has prophesied events accurately before concerning the Church of Starry Wisdom.
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path… I can only imagine that the prison will be a little slice of hell.  I'm not sure what they would have decided to do with the inmates when they knew death was almost certain.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: The worst case scenario will probably be that the prisoners have escaped their cells and turned the building into their own little fortress.  Best case, the building went into lock-down and secured the prisoners in their cells.  Either way, navigating the building will pose its own difficulties.
dialogue.success: Thank you, I'm not sure what to make of this but I'll ponder your account.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.describe: Well damn, you must be the guys here to pick me up…
dialogue.offer: I got the brief so I know what I'm getting into.  Let me be upfront, treat me like shit and I'm going to cover my own hide.  However, you treat me well and give me something to believe in, even if it's just a shiny bit of metal, and I'll do you right.  Without a strong band a man doesn't stand a chance in this world.  You ready to take charge boss?  This world could use a Sheriff just about now.
dialogue.accepted: Before we get into a major fight just make sure we have the gear we need, boss.
dialogue.rejected: I don't think you're going to find many other survivors who haven't taken up a faction yet.
dialogue.advice: I'm a pretty good shot with a rifle or pistol.
dialogue.success: Wait… are you really making me a deputy?
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think so…
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

dialogue.describe: You seem to know this new world better than most…
dialogue.offer: You're kitted out better than most… would you be interested in making this world a little better for the rest of us?  The towns have enough supplies for us survivors to start securing a foothold but we don't have anyone with the skills and equipment to thin the masses of undead.  I'll lend you a hand to the best of my ability but you really showed promise taking out that other beast.  You, I, and a 100 zombies laid to rest, what do you say?
dialogue.accepted: Hell ya, we may get ourselves killed but we'll be among the first legends of the apocalypse.
dialogue.rejected: Hey, I know I wouldn't volunteer for it either… but then I remember that most of us survivors won't make it unless someone decides to take the initiative.
dialogue.advice: I'd secure an ammo cache and try to sweep a town in multiple passes.
dialogue.success: Man… you're a goddamn machine.  It was a pleasure working with you.  You know, you may just change our little neck of the world if you keep this up.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think that was quite a hundred dead zeds.
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

dialogue.describe: I've heard some bad rumors so I hope you are up for another challenge…
dialogue.offer: Apparently one of the other survivors picked up on an unusually dense horde of undead moving into the area.  At the center of this throng there was a 'leader' of some sort.  The short of it is, kill the son of a bitch.  We don't know what it is capable of or why it is surrounded by other zombies but this thing reeks of trouble.  Do whatever it takes but we can't risk it getting away.
dialogue.accepted: I'll lend you a hand but I'd try and recruit another gunslinger if you can.
dialogue.rejected: What's the use of walking away, they'll track you down eventually.
dialogue.advice: Don't risk torching the building it may be hiding in if it has a basement.  The sucker may still be alive under the rubble and ash.
dialogue.success: May that bastard never get up again.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think we got it yet.
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

dialogue.describe: The eater of the dead… something was ripping zombies to shreds and only leaving a few scattered limbs…
dialogue.offer: A few days ago another survivor and I were trying to avoid the cities by staying in the woods during the day and foraging for gear at night.  It worked well against the normal zeds but one night something caught onto our trail and chased us for ten minutes or so until we decided to split up and meet-up back here.  My buddy never showed up and I don't have the means to kill whatever it was.  Can you lend a hand?
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, make sure you're ready for whatever the beast is.
dialogue.rejected: Hey, I know I wouldn't volunteer for it either.
dialogue.advice: I'd carry a shotgun at least, it sounded pretty big.
dialogue.success: You look a little shaken up, I can't tell you how glad I am that you killed it though.
dialogue.success_lie: Something in the shadows still seems to stare at me when I look at the woods.
dialogue.failure: I'm glad you came back alive… I wasn't sure if I had sent you to your death.

dialogue.describe: Oh god, I can't believe it happened…
dialogue.offer: My mom… she's… she was killed, but then she just got back up… she's one of those things now.  Can you put her out of her misery for me?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you… she would've wanted it this way.
dialogue.rejected: Please reconsider, I know she's suffering…
dialogue.advice: Find a gun if you can, make it quick…
dialogue.inquire: Well…?  Did you… finish things for my mom?
dialogue.success: Thank you.  I couldn't rest until I knew that was finished.
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: Really… that's too bad.

dialogue.describe: I just need a place to start over…
dialogue.offer: I've accepted that everyone I used to know is dead… one way or another.  I really wish I could have done something to save my brother but he was one of the first to go.  I'd like to start over, just rebuild at one of the farms in the countryside.  Can you help me secure one?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, let's find a remote one so we don't have to worry about many zombies.
dialogue.rejected: Please, I just don't know what to do otherwise.
dialogue.advice: Traveling the backroads would be a good way to search for one.
dialogue.inquire: Shall we keep looking for a farm house?
dialogue.success: Well, my adventuring days are over.  I can't thank you enough.  Trying to make this place self sustaining will take some work but the future is looking brighter.  At least it ought to be safe for now.  You'll always be welcome here.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: I guess it was just a pipe dream.

dialogue.describe: Maybe they escaped to one of the camps…
dialogue.offer: I can't thank you enough for bringing me the patient records but I do have another request.  You seem to know your way around… could you take me to one of the FEMA camps?  I know some were overrun but I don't want to believe all of them could have fallen.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, just bring me to the camp… I just want to see.
dialogue.rejected: Please, I don't know what else to do.
dialogue.advice: We should go at night, if it is overrun then we can quickly make our escape.
dialogue.inquire: Any leads on where a camp might be?
dialogue.success: I guess this wasn't as bright an idea as I thought.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: I bet some of them are still out there…

MISSION_RECOVER_PRIEST_DIARY.name: Recover Priest's Diary
MISSION_RECOVER_PRIEST_DIARY.description: Find something that may reveal what the church's stance is on these events.  Something like <color_yellow>a priest's diary</color> would suffice.

dialogue.describe: St. Michael the archangel defend me in battle…
dialogue.offer: From what I understand, the creatures you encountered surrounding this relic were unlike anything I've heard of.  It is laughable that I now consider the living dead to be part of our ordinary reality.  Never-the-less, the church must have some explanation for these events.  I have located the residence of a local clergy man, could you go to this address and recover any items that may reveal what the church's stance is on these events?
dialogue.accepted: I wish you the best of luck, may whatever god you please guide your path.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, I guess the stress may just be getting to me…
dialogue.advice: If the information is confidential the priest must have it hidden within his own home.
dialogue.success: Thank you, a diary is exactly what I was looking for.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_RECRUIT_TRACKER.name: Recruit Tracker
MISSION_RECRUIT_TRACKER.description: Go to the cabin in the woods where the Tracker is camping and <color_yellow>recruit them</color>.

dialogue.describe: You seem to know this new world better than most…
dialogue.offer: We've got another problem to deal with but I don't think we can handle it on our own.  So, I sent word out and found us a volunteer… of sorts.  He's vain as hell but has a little skill with firearms.  He was supposed to collect whatever he had of value and is going to meet us at a cabin in the woods.  Wasn't sure how long we were going to be so I told him to just camp there until we picked him up.
dialogue.accepted: Roger, if he's a no-show then any other gunslinger will do… but I doubt he'll quit before we even begin.
dialogue.rejected: Hey, I know I wouldn't volunteer for it either… but then I remember that most of us survivors won't make it unless someone decides to take the initiative.
dialogue.advice: I hope the bastard is packing heat… else we'll need to grab him a gun before we hit our next target.
dialogue.success: Great, just let me know when you are ready to wade knee-deep in an ocean of blood.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't think so…
dialogue.failure: Quitting already?

dialogue.offer: I left my poor dog in a house, not far from here.  Can you retrieve it?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you!  Please hurry back!
dialogue.rejected: Please, think of my poor little puppy!
dialogue.advice: Take my dog whistle; if the dog starts running off, blow it and he'll return to your side.
dialogue.inquire: Have you found my dog yet?
dialogue.success: Thank you so much for finding him!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You're lying, I can tell!  Ugh, forget it!
dialogue.failure: Oh no!  My poor puppy…

MISSION_GET_CITY_COP_MOMENTO.name: Break into armory to retrieve family photo
MISSION_GET_CITY_COP_MOMENTO.name_plural: Break into armory to retrieve family photos

dialogue.describe: I need you to get my family photo from the armory safe.
dialogue.offer: I left the only photo I have from my family in the armory.  I don't have the code, can you get in?
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, it's great to see someone willing to help a out.
dialogue.rejected: Well, I'll find someone else to do it for me, real shame with all those guns locked up too…
dialogue.advice: You look like a resourceful sort, maybe you can hack it or something.
dialogue.inquire: Got the photo?  Should've been in my gun safe.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  I'll be sure to put in a good word for you around town.
dialogue.success_lie: OK, then hand it over.
dialogue.failure: Shit happens.

MISSION_PROVE_YOUR_WORTH.name: Prove your worth to Foodperson
MISSION_PROVE_YOUR_WORTH.description: Prove your dedication to the Foodperson and Foodplace as a whole by finding <color_yellow>10 Foodplace loyalty cards</color>.

dialogue.offer: Show me the proof of your loyalty to the great Foodplace, and I'll consider you worthy of my friendship.  Ten loyalty cards should be enough, I'm sure you already have much more than that waiting for you at home, right?
dialogue.accepted: That's the spirit!  Good luck kid.
dialogue.rejected: That's alright not everyone is cutout for this.
dialogue.advice: Those are very precious, people would probably keep them on their person or in bank vaults.  And definitely not throw them in the trash!
dialogue.inquire: How is it going?  Do you have them?
dialogue.success: YES!  I knew you could do it!  You proved your worth and I'm proud to call you a friend.
dialogue.success_lie: Well… where are they?
dialogue.failure: I'm so disappointed in you kid…

MISSION_PROVE_YOU_ARE_A_SURVIVOR.name: Prove You're A Survivor
MISSION_PROVE_YOU_ARE_A_SURVIVOR.description: Prove you're a survivor by surviving for 10 days after the Cataclysm, and then returning to the person who gave you this mission.

dialogue.describe: It's hard to tell who actually has the skills to survive these days…
dialogue.offer: It's hard surviving out here on our own, and we'd probably have a better chance working together.  Problem is, I don't really know you and what you're capable of.  You might have what it takes, or you might not.  Either way, I'm going to need some proof.  Come back in a few days and I'll gladly follow you.  It's basically a win-win for me: either you come back and I'll know you've got what it takes, or you don't and I'll know that I was right not to follow you.
dialogue.accepted: I'll see you then… or I won't, and then I'll know I made the right decision.
dialogue.rejected: Ya, it was a long shot I admit.
dialogue.advice: Don't die.  If you're asking me for advice, that doesn't bode well for you.
dialogue.success: I'll be honest, I wasn't really expecting to see you again.  A promise is a promise, I'll follow you now!
dialogue.success_lie: I know time is relative and all that.
dialogue.failure: I'm not quite sure how you failed to survive AND are talking to me.

MISSION_LEARN_ABOUT_CATTAIL_JELLY.name: Gather cattail stalks to create cattail jelly
MISSION_LEARN_ABOUT_CATTAIL_JELLY.name_plural: Gather cattail stalks to create cattail jellys
MISSION_LEARN_ABOUT_CATTAIL_JELLY.description: Gather <color_yellow>60 cattail stalks</color> from the swamp and bring them back to <color_light_red>learn how to craft cattail jelly</color>.  Raise your <color_yellow>survival skill to at least 1</color> by harvesting cattail stalks.  <color_yellow>Bring back the provided bag with the 60 cattail stalks in them</color> as well.

effect.u_message: You learn how to craft cattail jelly.

dialogue.describe: Medical services are a little sparse following <the_cataclysm>, but people have been surviving using their wits and the bounty of Mother Nature for a long time.  Care to learn a little?
dialogue.offer: Did you know that cattails are a source of a jelly that works as an antiseptic and analgesic?  Something like that is likely to be mighty helpful out here.  I want you to take this bag, head to the nearest swamp, collect 60 cattail stalks, and bring them back here.  In exchange, I'll show you how to harvest the jelly.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  <color_yellow>This bag should be big enough to hold all of the stalks we'll need.  Don't forget to bring it back.</color>
dialogue.rejected: Your loss.
dialogue.advice: The cattails grow in the fresh water in swamps.  You can't miss them.
dialogue.inquire: Got those cattail stalks yet?  Don't forget to <color_yellow>bring back my bag with the stalks in them</color> and to work on improving your survival skill as well.
dialogue.success: Great!  Hand them over and I'll show you how this works.
dialogue.success_lie: OK, then hand them over.
dialogue.failure: Well, that's a shame.

MISSION_PYROMANIAC.name: Angry pyromaniac
MISSION_PYROMANIAC.description: Bring the pyromaniac to <color_light_blue>their rival's house</color> and don't forget to <color_yellow>bring at least 200 units of gasoline</color>.  After you got there, talk to the pyromaniac to start burning the house.

dialogue.describe: Oh man, I want to fucking burn it so bad…
dialogue.offer: I'm so fucking infuriated!  I've got an enemy that ruined my life, and now I want to get revenge!  I don't care about <the_cataclysm>, I just want to burn his house!  Would you help me, <name_g>?
dialogue.accepted: Good.  Let's go to his house and goddamn burn it down!  Oh, by the way, could you bring gasoline with you, <name_g>?  I was so angry I forgot to bring it with me…
dialogue.rejected: Seriously?  It's such an easy job…
dialogue.advice: Maybe we can find some gasoline at a gas station.
dialogue.success: Sweet, sweet revenge!  Ah, smells so nice!  Feels like the smell of napalm in the morning!  All his stuff, and probably even that <name_b>, will burn to ashes in a matter of minutes.  You helped me get my revenge, so I'll follow you to the end, <name_g>!
dialogue.success_lie: What?!  You liar!
dialogue.failure: Wow, you failed?  How…

MISSION_INVESTIGATE_PORTAL_DUNGEON.name: Investigate Strange Location
MISSION_INVESTIGATE_PORTAL_DUNGEON.description: You could find this place upside down, dizzy and blindfolded.  Its presence is too altered to allow the mercy of ignorance.

MISSION_INVESTIGATE_PORTAL_STORM_CENTER.name: Center of the storm
MISSION_INVESTIGATE_PORTAL_STORM_CENTER.description: This is the center of the portal storm, you could find it upside down, dizzy and blindfolded.  Its presence is too altered to allow the mercy of ignorance.

MISSION_CAMP_LEADERSHIP_CHANGE.name: Faction succession
MISSION_CAMP_LEADERSHIP_CHANGE.description: You have some time left until you can transfer control to your companions, provided you have <color_yellow>established a Basecamp</color> and <color_yellow>have at least 1 NPC companion</color>.

MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS.name: Follow the old map
MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS.description: I found an old notebook full of text I didn't understand.  However, I could understand the map drawn on the inside cover.  Where could it lead, in this strange place?

MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_2.name: Follow the old map
MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_2.description: I found an old map detailing a maze in the depths.  Where could it lead, in this strange place?

MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3a.name: Follow the subway map
MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3a.description: I found a strange subway map with a location circled.  Where could it lead, in this strange place?

MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3b.name: Follow the subway map
MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3b.description: I found a strange subway map with a location circled.  Where could it lead, in this strange place?

MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3c.name: Follow the subway map
MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3c.description: I found a strange subway map with a location circled.  Where could it lead, in this strange place?

MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3d.name: Follow the subway map
MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3d.description: I found a strange subway map with a location circled.  Where could it lead, in this strange place?

MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3e.name: Follow the subway map
MISSION_INNER_CABINS_GO_TO_DEPTHS_3e.description: I found a strange subway map with a location circled.  Where could it lead, in this strange place?

MISSION_KILL_SLIMES.name: Sticky Situation
MISSION_KILL_SLIMES.description: Kill some slimes in exchange for credit with some of the traders and bring back six of their slime scraps.

dialogue.offer: We've had some trouble with slimes not far from us.  It's been hard going through there with all them around, so I want you to go take care of it.
dialogue.advice: Sure, they can be cut, but I'd say it's better to splatter them with something large and heavy.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.
dialogue.rejected: No problem.  I'm sure one of us will get to it anyway.
dialogue.success: Nice.  I'll just take those off your hands.  Might be good for greasing the bike chains and door hinges around here even though it is a bit… abnormal.
dialogue.success_lie: You don't look nearly as sticky as you're supposed to.  Get back to it.
dialogue.failure: Did they give you the slip?  It's worse than I thought, then.

MISSION_HUNT_ANTS.name: Arthropod Hunting
MISSION_HUNT_ANTS.description: Kill some ants and bring back ten slices of their meat in exchange for credit with some of the traders.

dialogue.offer: The last time we went out scouting we found some gargantuan ants crawling around.  We thought we might see how they taste, if they could be cooked and whatnot.  I want you to go kill one and bring back some of its meat.
dialogue.advice: A shotgun of some sort might work well.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.
dialogue.success: Nice.  I'll get these cooked up.  Who knows, we might want some more in the future.
dialogue.success_lie: You sure?  I don't see my meat anywhere.
dialogue.failure: Ah, well.  It's no big deal.

dialogue.offer: My buddies and I have decided to stay here for a while.  This is about the only safe place out here, and it's kinda become our home.  Anyway, we're going to build a wall.  Our old logs have provided a bunch of the wood, but we still need quite a few planks.  About 100 of them.  If you could get it for us, I'd be grateful.
dialogue.advice: Any nearby forest should have all you need.  Otherwise, you might try breaking down some furniture in town.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  We'll be sure to compensate your efforts.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.  I guess I'll have to get it myself.
dialogue.success: Thank you.  We'll start right away.
dialogue.success_lie: I can tell you're lying.  I don't see shit.
dialogue.failure: Ah, well.  It's no big deal.

dialogue.offer: Now that we've got the wall done, we decided to move out of these old tents.  We still have some leftover nails but we need more wood.  So, if you could get us 150 planks, we'd be grateful.
dialogue.advice: Any nearby forest should have all you need.  Otherwise, you might try breaking down some furniture in town.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  We'll be sure to compensate your efforts.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.  I guess I'll have to get it myself.
dialogue.success: Thank you.  We'll start right away.
dialogue.success_lie: I can tell you're lying.  I don't see shit.
dialogue.failure: Ah, well.  It's no big deal.

dialogue.offer: Our entrance is wide open so we're building a gate over it.  Problem is we don't have any ropes.  If you could find some for us, we'll pay you.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find any rope around, one of our books should have something on rope-making.  Most plants can be woven into a halfway decent rope.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  We'll be sure to compensate your efforts.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.  I guess I'll have to get it myself.
dialogue.success: Thank you.  We'll start right away.
dialogue.success_lie: I can tell you're lying.  I don't see shit.
dialogue.failure: Ah, well.  It's no big deal.

dialogue.offer: We appreciate all of your help but we can't rely on everyone else to do things for us.  I'd be willing to buy a wood saw of some kind from you so we can cut our own wood as needed.
dialogue.advice: A hardware store or lumbermill should have one.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  We'll be sure to compensate your efforts.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.  I guess I'll have to get it myself.
dialogue.success: Thank you.  Pick what you want from our stash.
dialogue.success_lie: I can tell you're lying.  I don't see shit.
dialogue.failure: Ah, well.  It's no big deal.

dialogue.offer: Our sanitation here has become… problematic.  We've mostly just been going outside the walls to piss.  Not only is it kinda unhealthy, but the last time I wandered out I almost got eaten!  So, if you'd get us a shovel, we could make a latrine for ourselves.  We'll pay you fairly, as usual.
dialogue.advice: A hardware store should have one lying around.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  We'll be sure to compensate your efforts.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.  I guess I'll have to get it myself.
dialogue.success: Thank you.  We're eternally grateful to you.
dialogue.success_lie: I can tell you're lying.  I don't see shit.
dialogue.failure: I'll do it myself, then.

dialogue.offer: Turns out that ant meat you got us wasn't actually too bad.  A little tough, sure, but perfectly edible.  The problem now is we need a way of preserving it.  One of those portable charcoal smokers would be really great.  Heck, you might even wanna buy some.
dialogue.advice: Maybe try a farm?  I bet those rural folks were pretty invested in preserving their food.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  We'll be sure to compensate your efforts.
dialogue.rejected: Alright, I can understand that.  I guess I'll have to get it myself.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the charcoal smoker?
dialogue.success: Thank you.  We'll get started right away.
dialogue.success_lie: I can tell you're lying.  I don't see shit.
dialogue.failure: Ah, well.  It's no big deal.

MISSION_meteorologist_1.name: Find scrap for the meteorologist
MISSION_meteorologist_1.description: The meteorologist asked to bring him 50 pieces of scrap.

dialogue.describe: We need scrap metal to assemble a drone…
dialogue.offer: I've been sitting here for a long time, and all that time I was wondering how bad everything is outside.  I want to build a drone that I can use to fly over New England, check the air condition, take a few pictures from above to get a glimpse of how is it.  There were a lot of things in our back room that could be useful, but still I'm missing a lot of things.  You look like an experienced survivalist.  Can you help me?
dialogue.accepted: Good.  I just need a little stuff: 50 scrap, 6 medium batteries, 5 small high-quality lenses and a radio remote control.  Bring the scrap for now, but don't forget about the rest.
dialogue.rejected: Maybe another time…
dialogue.advice: I don't think this is a difficult task.  Surely there is a lot of it underfoot.
dialogue.success: Great, I'm starting to work on it…
dialogue.success_lie: Why do you say that?

MISSION_meteorologist_2.name: Find batteries for the meteorologist
MISSION_meteorologist_2.description: The meteorologist asked to bring him 6 medium batteries.

dialogue.describe: We need batteries to assemble a drone…
dialogue.offer: Well, what's next on the list… yeah, batteries.  6 medium batteries would be enough.
dialogue.accepted: I'm waiting for you.
dialogue.rejected: Maybe another time…
dialogue.advice: Try looking for some battery-powered trinkets and take them apart.
dialogue.success: Great, I'll continue to work on it…
dialogue.success_lie: Why do you say that?

MISSION_meteorologist_3.name: Find high-quality lenses for the meteorologist
MISSION_meteorologist_3.name_plural: Find high-quality lenses for the meteorologists
MISSION_meteorologist_3.description: The meteorologist asked to bring him 5 small high-quality lenses.

dialogue.describe: We need small high quality lenses for our drone…
dialogue.offer: Well, what's next on the list… yeah, lenses.  5 small high-quality lenses would be enough.
dialogue.accepted: I'm waiting for you.
dialogue.rejected: Maybe another time…
dialogue.advice: Try looking for telescopes or microscopes to dismantle.
dialogue.success: Great, I'm continuing to work on it…
dialogue.success_lie: Why do you say that?

MISSION_meteorologist_4.name: Find a radio controller for the meteorologist
MISSION_meteorologist_4.name_plural: Find a radio controller for the meteorologists
MISSION_meteorologist_4.description: The meteorologist asked to bring him a radio controller.

dialogue.describe: We need an RC to assemble a drone…
dialogue.offer: Well, what's next on the list… yeah, radio control.  Any kind will do, but the simplest one is better, so I can easily reconfigure it for my drone.
dialogue.accepted: I'm waiting for you.
dialogue.rejected: Maybe another time…
dialogue.advice: I advise you to search in a store, such as electronics or toy store.
dialogue.success: Great, very little work left.  I need a few days to finish all this, and to try it in work.  I hope everything will work fine!  While I'm working on the drone, you can read this book.  Maybe you can learn something new from it.
dialogue.success_lie: Why do you say that?

MISSION_meteorologist_5.name: Find the meteorologist's crashed drone
MISSION_meteorologist_5.description: The meteorologist asked to bring him his crashed drone.

dialogue.describe: I've lost the drone, we should find out what happened…
dialogue.offer: I'm glad that you are alive and that you haven't forgot about me.  The drone turned out to be great, it managed to take off and even was able to fly several hundred meters!  Unfortunately, after that, I lost control of it… I don't know what happened to it, though.  Maybe you can check?  I'm a little afraid to go out there…
dialogue.accepted: I'm waiting for you.
dialogue.rejected: Maybe another time…
dialogue.advice: I don't know quite what happened.  Maybe something noticed my drone and tried to bring it down.  Be careful.
dialogue.success: Hmm, I see that the drone is not with you.  Maybe at least the memory module remains?  Okay, show it to me… hmm, situation is worse than I expected, much, much worse… I'm not feeling good.  I don't feel safe in this place anymore.  I have to run, run somewhere.  But where to run if these monsters are everywhere…
dialogue.success_lie: Why do you say that?

MISSION_pizzaiolo_1.name: Angry pizzaiolo
MISSION_pizzaiolo_1.description: Bring the pizzaiolo to <color_light_blue>their rival's house</color> and don't forget to <color_yellow>bring at least 200 units of gasoline</color>.  After you got there, talk to the pizzaiolo to start burning the house.

dialogue.offer: I'm so angry!  I have an enemy that ruined my life, and I want revenge for it!  I don't care about <the_cataclysm>, I just want to burn his <freaking> restaurant!  Will you help me?
dialogue.accepted: Good.  Let's go to his restaurant and fucking burn it!  Oh, by the way, could you bring gasoline with you, <name_g>?  I was so angry I forgot to bring it with me…
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Why do you… ah, forget it.
dialogue.advice: Maybe we can find some gasoline at a gas station.
dialogue.success: Sweet, sweet revenge!  It smells so nice!  His restaurant burns, his legacy is now ruined!  Even if he became a <zombie>, it still good.

MISSION_pizzaiolo_2.name: Find TrueFoodperson
MISSION_pizzaiolo_2.description: Help pizzaiolo find TrueFoodperson and kick his ass.

dialogue.offer: Ah, it's you, <name_g>.  Wanna continue on my revenge to all American <name_b>s?
dialogue.accepted: Good.  Next stop, Foodplace.  I always hated that place, especially that <freaking> <name_b> in his idiotic mask.  I know he's still alive, hiding in his dumb parody of a restaurant.  Take this bat.  Let's take a visit to him, <name_g>, and kick his <freaking> ass!
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Why do you… ah, forget it.
dialogue.advice: I heard that these 'restaurants' use some kind of locking system for staff room, so we would need to find a way to get there.
dialogue.success: Another one bite the dust!  We did good, <name_g>.

MISSION_pizzaiolo_3.name: Pizza parlor
MISSION_pizzaiolo_3.description: Help pizzaiolo take back his restaurant.

dialogue.offer: I need to make a last step to achieve my revenge, and the step is - my pizza parlor.  Before <the_cataclysm>, the bank took my place, and now, some <freaking> <name_b>s occupied it and made it their base!  Just unbelievable, I tell ya.  It's time for me to fight back, deal with this <freaking> <name_b>s and regain my honor.  Are you with me, <name_g>?
dialogue.accepted: Very good.  <lets_go>
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Why do you… ah, forget it.
dialogue.advice: These <name_b>s might be heavily armed, so we need to prepare to face them.
dialogue.success: Nice, very fucking nice.  Fuck, this placed is thrashed.  <freaking> <name_b>s thrashed my restaurant!  Okay, calm down, calm down, will ya… At least I retrieved my place.  Thank you, <name_g>.  I couldn't make it without you.

MISSION_pizzaiolo_4.name: Family house
MISSION_pizzaiolo_4.description: First bring pizzaiolo some chocolate cake then lead him to his family house.

effect.u_message: You learn how to craft cake.

dialogue.offer: Now, as my competitors dead, their places are ruined, it's time to relax… I know, let's celebrate it!  Lead me to my house.  Also, we need a cake for that.  What celebration without a cake, right?  I can teach you how to cook it, if you want.
dialogue.accepted: Good.  Bring me chocolate cake and talk to me.
dialogue.rejected: What?!  Why do you… ah, forget it.
dialogue.advice: If you listened to me very closely, it wouldn't be hard for you to make it.  Good luck, <name_g>.
Be careful.  Seems like a rough place to me.
dialogue.success: Sweet.
dialogue.success_lie: Sweet.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.

dialogue.advice: Be careful.  Seems like a rough place to me.
dialogue.success: Sweet.
dialogue.success_lie: Sweet.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.

dialogue.advice: Be careful.  Seems like a rough place to me.
dialogue.success: Sweet.
dialogue.success_lie: Sweet.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.

dialogue.describe: Things must be better at the camp…
dialogue.offer: We're all in this together, looking forward to meeting you there.
dialogue.accepted: Everything is going to be all right.
dialogue.rejected: No worries friend, good luck to you.
dialogue.advice: The hard part is getting there.
dialogue.inquire: Any progress on getting to the camp?
dialogue.success: Well, success I guess.
dialogue.success_lie: Thanks for trying… I guess.
dialogue.failure: Such a disappointment…

dialogue.describe: Gotta start small right?  Little ones for keeping little things safe.  I could use 'em.
dialogue.offer: Gotta start small right?  Little ones for keeping little things safe.  I could use 'em.  I need a bunch of 'em.  Little ones, you know?  Can you bring me like… like… forty?
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much my friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: Watch out, he's looking for it too.
dialogue.success: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.success_lie: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.  Guess they're eating it all.

MISSION_BEGGAR_2_DUCT_TAPE.name: Bring a roll of duct tape (200 charges)
MISSION_BEGGAR_2_DUCT_TAPE.name_plural: Bring a roll of duct tape (200 charges)s

dialogue.describe: These ones are good, good ones.  They need something to, you know, bind them together.  Surround them, light side, dark side.
dialogue.offer: These ones are good, good ones.  They need something to, you know, bind them together.  Surround them, light side, dark side.  Bring me the Force!
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much my friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: Watch out, he's looking for it too.
dialogue.inquire: It's all around us… but did you get it in a crude matter form?
dialogue.success: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.success_lie: Oh this is so great, so great!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.  Guess they're eating it all.

dialogue.describe: Ten bigger ones now please.  The list doesn't lie.  You've done so well.
dialogue.offer: Ten bigger ones now please.  The list doesn't lie.  You've done so well.  I got a little more on the list, but we're more than half there.
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much my friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: Watch out, he's looking for it too.
dialogue.success: I'm so happy now!
dialogue.success_lie: I'm so happy now!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.  Guess they're eating it all.

dialogue.describe: If I can set it up in here I won't need it, but they might drive me out, so I guess I need some plastic just in case.  I don't like it, the sandman can smell through plastic, but I think the cardboard is stronger.
dialogue.offer: If I can set it up in here I won't need it, but they might drive me out, so I guess I need some plastic just in case.  I don't like it, the sandman can smell through plastic, but I think the cardboard is stronger.  Please bring me some plastic sheets.
dialogue.accepted: We're almost there, now.
dialogue.rejected: I didn't think so.
dialogue.advice: They keep a lot of this stuff in hardware stores and lumber yards.
dialogue.inquire: I really feel bad sending you on this one, it's dangerous.  Have you found anything?
dialogue.success: Nice, this will do perfectly!
dialogue.success_lie: Nice, this will do perfectly!
dialogue.failure: Oh, that's too bad.

dialogue.describe: This is the last thing I need from you.  I've been collecting the other parts myself, it's been easier with more cardboard around.  Can you bring me five more really big cardboard boxes?
dialogue.offer: This is the last thing I need from you.  I've been collecting the other parts myself, it's been easier with more cardboard around.  Can you bring me five more really big cardboard boxes?  Five more cardboard boxes, as big as it gets.  I have a few already stored up, that should be all I need.
dialogue.accepted: Yes!  The home stretch!
dialogue.rejected: Oh man, but we're so close!
dialogue.advice: Try looking in cargo storage areas.
dialogue.inquire: Did you bring me those last few boxes?
dialogue.success: Brilliant!  You're a true hero.  I'll see if I can find a place to set these up now.
dialogue.success_lie: Brilliant!  You're a true hero.  I'll see if I can find a place to set these up now.
dialogue.failure: No!  Oh god, no, this can't be happening…

MISSION_BEGGAR_2_PERMISSION.name: Talk to Smokes about finding Dave a place to call home.
MISSION_BEGGAR_2_PERMISSION.name_plural: Talk to Smokes about finding Dave a place to call home.s

dialogue.describe: I have it, I have it all, but I can't find a place to put it.  Will you ask the masters?  Maybe?  I've tried but they ignore me.
dialogue.offer: I have it, I have it all, but I can't find a place to put it.  Will you ask the masters?  Maybe?  I've tried but they ignore me.  I just need a place to put it all, a place I can be safe, and not make anyone upset.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you!  I'm sorry, I thought we were done, but we can do this!
dialogue.rejected: Oh man, but we're so close!
dialogue.advice: Maybe somewhere they can't see me?  Where I can just be me?
dialogue.success: The roof!  So high!  So lofty!  Come see me there, my friend.  I will not disappoint you.
dialogue.success_lie: I don't understand.
dialogue.failure: No!  Oh god, no, this can't be happening…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Alonso_pants.name: Alonso must have his special pants
MISSION_REFUGEE_Alonso_pants.name_plural: Alonso must have his special pantss
MISSION_REFUGEE_Alonso_pants.description: Find Alonso's leather pants in the 'toy shop' Alonso has marked on your map.

dialogue.describe: I think I might know where those special pants might be though…
dialogue.offer: This clown was into some of the different things, not the vanilla, you understand me?  Yes.  I think you will find my valuables in a toy shop not so far.
dialogue.accepted: You make me so happy I could give you little kisses, and some big kisses, and then something else maybe.
dialogue.rejected: I know that you cannot resist me long.  I will wait, and perhaps some other pretty thing will help me instead?
dialogue.advice: It may be crowded no?  A popular place before, maybe is better to visit at night.  Sounds like Alonso's apartment no?  Ah, and if something strange grabs you and another pair of leather pants comes to you, maybe Alonso is even happier?
dialogue.inquire: Have you found what it is that you seek?  There may be something in it for you no?  Something big, but we take it slow yes?
dialogue.success: This is the best news since those lonely teachers asked me to be a nude model at the college for the blind.  Alas, the special condoms have all been used.  This is not a surprise, few could resist this seductive clown.  You find a condom, I find a use for it.  Safety, she was never more important than now, in *so* many ways.
dialogue.success_lie: You give me confidence.  I trust you.  I do not know why this is.
dialogue.failure: Disaster, but I thank you for to try.  You want a backrub some time, it will happen for sure.  And maybe you give me a rub too?

MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_CLEANUP.name: Find someone to clean up the back bay.
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_CLEANUP.name_plural: Find someone to clean up the back bay.s
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_CLEANUP.description: Boris in the refugee center is looking for at least five people to help clean up the back bay.

dialogue.describe: Find a few people able to help clean the back, people without too much trauma there.
dialogue.offer: Yes, please.  If you can ask around for someone who can help, I can gather the tools they will need and some payment for them.
dialogue.accepted: You are a kind soul.
dialogue.rejected: Ah well.  I can ask around myself, perhaps.
dialogue.advice: Those of us here in the back have too many bad memories, but perhaps someone who didn't come with the original refugee groups would be less burdened.
dialogue.inquire: Greetings, my friend.  Have you found anyone?
dialogue.success: This has great promise.  Perhaps something to keep me busy will help.  Here, I found some small money to thank you.
dialogue.success_lie: I see….  Well I shall get things in order!
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_WORKSPACE.name: Bring Boris a circular saw.
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_WORKSPACE.description: Find a circular saw for Boris.  Smokes might be selling one if it's available in stock.

dialogue.describe: Find a circular saw for Boris.
dialogue.offer: We now have a space to work in, and I have wood and nails to spare.  All I need is a saw.  I would love a table saw and mitre saw, but I can work with a hand held circular saw for now.  I have looked, and what we have is garbage.  Can you bring me a good one?
dialogue.accepted: You are a kind soul.
dialogue.rejected: Ah well.  I can ask around myself, perhaps.
dialogue.advice: It is not hard to find.  I have even seen them for sale at the merchants, but they save them as trade goods and will not give me as a gift.
dialogue.inquire: Greetings, my friend.  Have you found a saw I can use?
dialogue.success: Ah, good.  VonWalt is good brand, I had a saw like this at home.  Now I shall set to work, and make myself a shop back there.  Oh yes, here is a little payment I saved.
dialogue.success_lie: I see…
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_LAPTOP.name: Bring Boris his son's lost writing.
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_LAPTOP.name_plural: Bring Boris his son's lost writing.s
MISSION_REFUGEE_Boris_LAPTOP.description: Find Boris' son's laptop in the evac shelter marked on your map.

dialogue.offer: My son, Ash, had a laptop on which he kept his writing.  If you can find it, it would mean so much to me.  I will give you directions to the shelter where he left it.  It was barely a shelter, broken and torn apart.  It should just be on the floor where it was dropped.
dialogue.accepted: You are a kind soul.
dialogue.rejected: Ah well.  I can ask around myself, perhaps.
dialogue.advice: You can tell it is his because he covered it in stickers.
dialogue.inquire: I know it is a hard thing to hope, but were you able to find Ash's laptop?
dialogue.success: It is so strange to see this again, like a little piece of my old life.  I don't know if I can bring myself to read what's on it yet, but having this piece of him is a great comfort.
dialogue.success_lie: I see…
dialogue.failure: Even that you tried means a lot to me.

dialogue.describe: I could get my real sourdough starter…
dialogue.offer: If you really like this second-rate bread, you could risk your life for something actually worth it.  I left my actual sourdough starter back in the bakery where I worked.  That baby is a hundred years old, and has been in my family for generations… if you can bring him to me, I'll bake you the finest bread you've ever had.
dialogue.accepted: Take care of yourself out there.  And listen, when you bring my sourdough back, I don't want to see a scratch on him, you understand?
dialogue.rejected: I can understand why you think you wouldn't want to risk your life for a bread starter.  You haven't tried that bread.
dialogue.advice: He'll be in the right-hand fridge, in a jar with a picture of the Millennium Falcon on it.
dialogue.inquire: So, you seen my sourdough starter?
dialogue.success: Oh, you will not regret this.  He may not look like much, but he's got it where it counts, kid.  It's gonna take me a few days to revive him after being abandoned so long, but he'll be operational soon and then you can come back for some real bread.
dialogue.success_lie: This ain't it.
dialogue.failure: I am not sure if I'm gonna make it through the Cataclysm without my special jar of goop.

dialogue.describe: Yeah, sure, imagine how things would be if we had some live music around here?  I don't know how much I could thank you, though, if you're looking for payment.  You'd sure be improving the mood, though.
dialogue.offer: I just want a functional acoustic guitar.  Preferably one that hasn't been used to cave in any zombie skulls.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  We'll be makin' music in no time!
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I understand your reluctance… I guess.
dialogue.advice: Well, I'll let you in on a little secret.  Guitars COULD be found at a music store.  Let that one sink in a bit.
dialogue.success: Hell yeah, bud!  You just made a lot of people really happy!  In thanks, I'll have enough cash to offer you more recompense for our little dealings.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This… is something, isn't it.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  They don't grow from trees, but we have time.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Fatima_1.name: Find a copy of the Quran
MISSION_REFUGEE_Fatima_1.name_plural: Find a copy of the Qurans

dialogue.describe: I could use a bit of help to find a copy of the Quran.
dialogue.offer: I feel silly asking this, but here goes.  I've never been really into reading holy books and stuff like that.  I usually went to the mosque on Friday, and I try to pray five times a day but I hardly ever manage it.  I guess I'm not a very good Muslim, but with all that's happened I would really love to have a copy of the Quran to read.  This seems like a time to get back in touch with God, you know?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  I'll see if I can save up a little reward for you.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  Thanks for offering.
dialogue.advice: It's not as common as the bible, but you should be able to find copies in most libraries and bookstores, or in religious buildings.  Make sure you get the translated version, I can't read Arabic!
dialogue.success: Thank you so much.  Just having a copy to keep at hand does actually feel pretty comforting.  I did a few extra rounds of chores and saved the proceeds for if you managed this, here you go.  It's not much but I hope it helps.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do me?
dialogue.failure: It's okay.  I don't know how much comfort I'd have found in an old book anyway.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Jenny_GET_PNEUMATICS.name: Find reference material about air rifles for Jenny.
MISSION_REFUGEE_Jenny_GET_PNEUMATICS.name_plural: Find reference material about air rifles for Jenny.s
MISSION_REFUGEE_Jenny_GET_PNEUMATICS.description: Find reference material about air rifles.  <color_yellow>A book that has 'Pneumatic' in its name</color> could be the thing she wants.  She probably wants a physical copy, if I can find it.

dialogue.describe: If you happen to see anything in your travels about high-powered air rifles, it would help a lot.
dialogue.offer: If you happen to see anything in your travels about high-powered air rifles, it would help a lot.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Bring it to me if you find one.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Thanks anyway.
dialogue.advice: Honestly I don't even have a search engine to find the name of a good book.  It's the air compression part I need to know about, gun books won't help much.
dialogue.inquire: Any sign of an air rifle book I can use?
dialogue.success: That's exactly what I need!  Here, I saved a few merch for you, I hope this helps cover your troubles.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This isn't going to work like I thought.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

dialogue.describe: Yeah, if you want to risk your neck out there and bring me what I need, I'm not gonna say no.  I can't, like, pay you or anything though, you know that right?
dialogue.offer: Before I get anything going, I'm going to need to set up a compressor.  I have a lot of the stuff for that, but I need a large tank for air, and a good sized electric motor - about 10 kg or so.  I'm also going to need a 60 liter tank, after that.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Bring it to me when you find one.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Thanks for offering anyway.
dialogue.advice: Try a basic hybrid car, or maybe farm equipment that uses an electric motor.  The kind on a bike would be too small, and the kind on those fancy Edison sports cars is going to be too big.
dialogue.inquire: Any sign of a motor I can use?
dialogue.success: That's exactly what I need!  Want to talk about that tank now?  I saved a few merch for you, by the way.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This isn't going to work like I thought.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Jenny_GET_TANK.name: Bring back a 60 L metal tank
MISSION_REFUGEE_Jenny_GET_TANK.name_plural: Bring back a 60 L metal tanks

dialogue.describe: Now that I've got that motor, I can get my compressor mostly built.  I will need a tank though.
dialogue.offer: I can get started building the compressor, but I need a large metal tank to store compressed air centrally.  About 60 liters should do…
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Bring it to me when you find one.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Thanks for offering anyway.
dialogue.advice: It needs to be a good strong tank, like a big propane tank or something… you could look at fuel storage tanks and things, as long as they're durable enough.  Heck, if you get some sheet metal you could probably even weld a good one together.
dialogue.inquire: Any sign of a tank I can use?
dialogue.success: Hey, this is perfect, "tanks" a bunch.  Okay, I'm sorry for that.  Anyway, now that I've got the parts, I might be able to build a proof of concept.  First I gotta get this thing up and running, and argue with the bean counters about letting me draw power to run it.  Oh right, and here's some merch, thanks for the help!
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This isn't going to work like I thought.  Back to the drawing board I guess.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Jenny_GET_TEXT.name: Find a gunsmithing textbook
MISSION_REFUGEE_Jenny_GET_TEXT.description: Find a gunsmithing textbook for Jenny.  <color_yellow>A book with 'Gunsmithing' and/or 'Firearm Design' in its name</color> will do.

dialogue.describe: I hate to admit it, but my first few tests haven't gone well.  I think I know what's wrong, but I need more information.
dialogue.offer: I need a good quality reference book on gunsmithing.  This isn't my area of expertise, and I don't want to blow anybody up.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  Bring it to me when you find one.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  Thanks for offering anyway.
dialogue.advice: This is a bit of a tricky one.  A college library would be a good start, and I imagine maybe military bases have that kind of thing?  I'm not entirely sure.
dialogue.inquire: Any luck looking for that gunsmithing text?
dialogue.success: Oh yeah.  Ooooh yeah.  Now we're cookin' with gas.  Here's a bit more merch, you beautiful gofer maniac.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh.  This isn't going to work like I thought.  Back to the drawing board I guess.
dialogue.failure: No worries.  Let me know if you want to try again.

MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_1.name: Find 50 doses of antiseptic
MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_1.description: Find 50 doses of antiseptic for Uyen Tran in the refugee center, in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> merch.

dialogue.offer: There's the doc out front helping anyone that can pay… but for us up here, money mostly goes to food.  I could do a lot for basic cuts, bruises, and common stuff if I had some supplies to help out.  Could you bring me some antiseptic?  Six bottles would probably be enough to last us a while.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much.  It's a small thing but it'd be really helpful.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  I'm sure we'll make do somehow.
dialogue.advice: Lots of people used to have first aid kits in their bathrooms.  I'm sure they can't all have been looted.
dialogue.success: Thanks so much.  Listen, I told some of the others what you were up to for us and we pooled our cash to thank you.  It's not much but I hope it helps… these are merch, the local money, you can trade them for goods from the shop.  A lot of us will take them in trade too.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_2.name: Find 30 bandages
MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_2.description: Find 30 bandages for Uyen Tran in the refugee center, in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> merch.

dialogue.offer: There's the doc out front helping anyone that can pay… but for us up here, money mostly goes to food.  I could do a lot for basic cuts, bruises, and common stuff if I had some supplies to help out.  Could you bring me a few extra bandages?  Thirty would probably be enough to last us a while.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much.  It's a small thing but it'd be really helpful.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  I'm sure we'll make do somehow.
dialogue.advice: Lots of people used to have first aid kits in their bathrooms.  I'm sure they can't all have been looted.
dialogue.success: Thanks so much.  Listen, I told some of the others what you were up to for us and we pooled our cash to thank you.  It's not much but I hope it helps… these are merch, the local money, you can trade them for goods from the shop.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_3.name: Find 60 doses of antidepressant
MISSION_REFUGEE_Uyen_3.description: Find 60 doses of antidepressant for Uyen Tran in the refugee center, in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> merch.

dialogue.describe: We could still use your help…
dialogue.offer: I probably shouldn't be prescribing things, but there's a ton of people needing help with sleep in here.  If you could get us some antidepressants, Rhyzaea and I can probably make sure they're doled out appropriately without people having to starve to pay for them.  Three month's worth - about 6 bottles - would last us a little while.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks so much.  It's a small thing but it'd be really helpful.
dialogue.rejected: That's okay.  I'm sure we'll make do somehow.
dialogue.advice: Antidepressant was really common.  You can probably find it in most medicine cabinets and pharmacies.
dialogue.success: Thanks so much.  Listen, I told some of the others what you were up to for us and we pooled our cash to thank you.  You've done a lot to help us out.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_REFUGEE_Vanessa_1.name: Make a makeshift haircut kit for Vanessa Toby in the refugee center
MISSION_REFUGEE_Vanessa_1.name_plural: Make a makeshift haircut kit for Vanessa Toby in the refugee centers

dialogue.describe: If I had some equipment, I could do some hairdresser work here.
dialogue.offer: I didn't think to pack my hairdressing equipment when I was evacuated.  If you could put together a basic hair cutting kit for me, I could do a bit of styling for people around here.  I'll even give you a free haircut for your troubles.
dialogue.accepted: Cool, thanks.  It'll be good to have something useful to do, and to not be staring at so many shaggy slobs.
dialogue.rejected: Whatever, I'll keep twiddling my thumbs then.
dialogue.advice: I don't need too much.  Scissors, a small mirror, a bit of cloth, and some way to keep it all stored clean when I'm not using it, like a leather pouch or something.  I can get the rest of what I need from shelter supplies.
dialogue.success: Well, this is pretty serviceable.  Heck, these scissors are nice enough that I could probably inexplicably make your hair longer or a different color with them.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do me?
dialogue.failure: Seriously?  You failed to find *scissors*?  How do you tie your shoes in the morning?

MISSION_BROKER_1.name: In a Pickle Pt. 2
MISSION_BROKER_1.description: Deliver 50 large three-liter jars in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> certified notes.

dialogue.describe: I do have some work for you.
dialogue.offer: You heard right.  When you brought in those canning jars, it got us thinking about expanding our food storage from dehydrated to include cans.  We could use some larger jars though for big stock items.  Can you bring me 50 large three liter jars?  I'll pay you a Certified Note per two.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you.  Once we get a cottage industry set up with some of our inhabitants, I'll be able to start buying these from you and other scavengers in smaller lots.  This should be enough to test out our equipment.
dialogue.rejected: Oh well.  I'll see if I can find another supplier, thanks.
dialogue.advice: Grocery stores, house kitchens, there's plenty of places to look.
dialogue.success: Wow, that's a lot more jars than it sounded on paper.  Thanks.  Here's your payment.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: I wonder where all the jars went…

MISSION_EVAC_SMOKER_GET_CIGARETTES.name: Smokes, let's go.
MISSION_EVAC_SMOKER_GET_CIGARETTES.description: Make a friend at the refugee center by handing over around five packs - 100 cigarettes.

dialogue.describe: Come on man, I just need a smoke.
dialogue.offer: With all that's been going on, it's been more and more difficult to find a smoke.  My stash has been running low for a while now.  Think you could help me out here?  A few packs is all I need.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, it's great to see someone willing to help a guy out.
dialogue.rejected: Well, I'll find someone else to do it for me.
dialogue.advice: Plenty of smokers in towns.  Gotta be some left over cigs in some of them houses.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  I'll be sure to put in a good word for you around the center.
dialogue.success_lie: OK, then hand it over.
dialogue.failure: Shit happens.

directions_isherwood.name: Check out that farm
directions_isherwood.description: Ran into a bunch of farmers.  They don't want much to do with our caravans, but someone like you they might be OK with.

dialogue.describe: Ran into a bunch of farmers.  They don't want much to do with our caravans, but someone like you they might be OK with.
dialogue.offer: Ran into a bunch of farmers.  They don't want much to do with our caravans, but someone like you they might be OK with.
dialogue.accepted: Nice.
dialogue.rejected: Seems reasonable.
dialogue.advice: Be careful.  It's rough out there.
dialogue.success: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.failure: It is what it is.

directions_hub01.name: Check out that lab
directions_hub01.description: There's been rumors.  Folks talkin' about some kind of secret lab, out in the wilds, with survivors in it.

dialogue.describe: There's been rumors.  Folks talkin' about some kind of secret lab, out in the wilds, with survivors in it.
dialogue.offer: There's been rumors.  Folks talkin' about some kind of secret lab, out in the wilds, with survivors in it.
dialogue.accepted: Nice.
dialogue.rejected: Seems reasonable.
dialogue.advice: Be careful.  It's rough out there.
dialogue.success: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.failure: It is what it is.

directions_exodii.name: Check out that scrap metal castle
directions_exodii.name_plural: Check out that scrap metal castles
directions_exodii.description: A few of my caravans have come back now talkin' about this giant metal castle on top of a rock, in the middle of nowhere.  They ain't been crazy enough to check it out, but you could if you want.

dialogue.describe: A few of my caravans have come back now talkin' about this giant metal castle on top of a rock, in the middle of nowhere.  They ain't been crazy enough to check it out, but you could if you want.
dialogue.offer: A few of my caravans have come back now talkin' about this giant metal castle on top of a rock, in the middle of nowhere.  They ain't been crazy enough to check it out, but you could if you want.
dialogue.accepted: Your funeral.
dialogue.rejected: Seems reasonable.
dialogue.advice: Be careful.  Seems like a rough place to me.
dialogue.success: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.failure: Seems reasonable.

directions_artisans.name: Check out that bullet bank
directions_artisans.description: A few of my people have come back now talkin' about some yuppie trying to start a bank that uses bullets for money.  Silly idea, but the lad lives on a homestead with a woman who wouldn't let my guys leave without a full belly.

dialogue.describe: A few of my people have come back now talkin' about some yuppie trying to start a bank that uses bullets for money.  Silly idea, but the lad lives on a homestead with a woman who wouldn't let my guys leave without a full belly.
dialogue.offer: A few of my people have come back now talkin' about some yuppie trying to start a bank that uses bullets for money.  Silly idea, but the lad lives on a homestead with a woman who wouldn't let my guys leave without a full belly.
dialogue.accepted: Hopefully they are still around.
dialogue.rejected: Seems reasonable.
dialogue.advice: Don't worry about the turrets they seem friendly to people.
dialogue.success: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh, go figure.
dialogue.failure: Seems reasonable.

MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_1.name: Procure a centrifuge
MISSION_SCIENCE_REP_1.description: You need to bring me a <color_light_blue>centrifuge</color>, equipment like this can most commonly be found at <color_light_blue>hospitals</color>, but you can also try to search for it at <color_light_blue>medical labs</color> then bring it back to the <color_light_blue>Doctor</color>.

dialogue.describe: It could be very useful to be able to perform an analysis of zombie blood…
dialogue.offer: We don't have the equipment for real analysis here so I'll need you to bring me one.  I've been authorized to reward the completion of this job with 30 merch, a sizeable sum of the local currency.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent.  Here, I'll note the location of a hospital nearby, with some luck you should be able to find a centrifuge in working condition there.
dialogue.rejected: Are you sure?  The data we could extract with that equipment could be priceless…
dialogue.advice: Centrifuges can be a bit heavy; you might want to locate a smaller one if you can, it will be way easier to transport.
dialogue.inquire: Well, do you have the centrifuge yet?
dialogue.success: Excellent!  This may be the key to removing the infection.
dialogue.success_lie: Wait, you couldn't possibly have the centrifuge!  Liar!
dialogue.failure: What a shame, that equipment could have proved invaluable…

dialogue.offer: The medical software didn't just analyze the blood, it triggered a government alert.  Medical staff was under orders to immediately drive any matching samples to the nearest laboratory.  That must mean the government knew!  We have the destination address.  Go there, get in, and bring back any records you can download off a computer.  Like last time, I can compensate you, and the Old Guard saw enough promise in this assignment to spare a larger sum of 60 merch.  I'm sure you're also free to lay claim to any valuables you might find at the target location.
dialogue.accepted: Great!  I've mapped out a route to the address.  Bring back anything you find on this secure USB drive.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: If the laboratory is locked, maybe you can find an id card from employees who died in the evacuation.  Don't forget the secure USB drive.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  This data looks damaged, but maybe I can make something out of it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…
