dialogue.offer: Unfortunately the data you got was incomplete and mostly encrypted.  There may be a way to get encryption codes, though.  I found a complaint by the infosec team that they were unable to deliver critical security updates to one research site.  It was some kind of more restricted secondary site, they weren't allowed in.  That means it should have unsecured computers we can get the codes from.  I couldn't secure any funding for this due to a lack of obvious results, but if you believe in this enough, maybe we can convince them otherwise?
dialogue.accepted: Great!  I've mapped out a route to the address.  Use this secure USB drive as usual.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: Expect the lab to be locked as usual.  Don't forget the secure USB drive.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  Now I just need to get an undamaged, complete archive, and we can really figure out what happened.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: So there looks to be months, maybe years of experiments, and that data set must be huge.  That data will have to be backed up somewhere secure and remote.  I heard of a lab that has data servers hidden in a high security vault on lower floors.  I bet the archives inside that lab are still working.  The Old Guard didn't seem very convinced, but still ended up providing 100 merch for this.
dialogue.accepted: Excellent!  I've mapped out a route to the address.  Bring back anything you find on this secure USB drive.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: That lab is going to be protected by various security systems.  You may need special access cards or a way to cut your way in.  Don't forget the secure USB drive.
dialogue.success: Thanks!  This is a lot of data to go through.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: In the data we found a major contract for tunneling and train equipment, ordered eight months ago.  It's the best lead we have.  Here's the address of the government lab where the equipment was delivered.  I want you to go there, find the tunnels that they dug, and download everything you can about the train network.  On the other hand, our sponsors were extremely impressed in getting this far without their direction, and would like to apologize by supporting this mission with a whole 300 merch!
dialogue.accepted: So glad for your help.
dialogue.rejected: Can't blame you, but come back if you change your mind.
dialogue.advice: The equipment was rated for 50 feet underground, so that tunnel entrance is going to be deeper inside a lab than a normal subway.  Fifty feet would mean maybe four stories down.  Don't forget the secure USB drive.
dialogue.success: Fantastic!  I should be able to reconstruct what cargo moved between which labs.  I wonder what was really going on down there.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_HUB_DELIVERY_1.name: Unknown Recipient
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_HUB_DELIVERY_1.description: Deliver the FEMA hard drive to the strange group that Smokes mentioned.  Return to the evacuation center when the data's been delivered.

dialogue.success: Oh, good.  I'm glad you're alright; I had no idea what to make of them.  Well, one less thing to worry about.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: At least you came back alive.  Don't sweat it too much - it's no skin off my back.  If they want it that bad, they can come get another copy themselves.

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_1.name: Clear Back Bay
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_1.description: Clear out the barricaded back area in the refugee center and lay the former leader of the Free Merchants to rest, in exchange for the local currency: Free Merchant certified notes.

dialogue.offer: If you really want to lend a hand we could use your help clearing out the dead in the back bay.  Fearful of going outside during the first days of the Cataclysm we ended up throwing our dead and the zombies we managed to kill in the sealed back bay.  Our promising leader at the time even fell… he turned into something different.  Kill all of them and make sure they won't bother us again.  We can't pay much, besides some of our own internal money which isn't good for that much yet, but it would help us to reclaim the bay.  <color_red>If you accept, I'll tell the guards to immediately take down the barricade in the back.  You should only accept if you're ready to do this now.</color>
dialogue.accepted: Please be careful, we don't need any more deaths.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: If you can, get a friend or two to help you.
dialogue.inquire: Will they be bothering us any longer?
dialogue.success: Thank you, having that big of a threat close to home was nerve wracking.  Here's some of our local certified notes, we've been paying these to our workers in exchange for supplies.  They're getting some value in the center as a trade item, I'm afraid they're all we have to spare at the moment.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_2.name: Missing Caravan
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_2.description: Investigate the last known location of a disappeared scavenger trading party, and eliminate any bandits or raiders in the vicinity in exchange for <reward_count:FMCNote> certified notes.

dialogue.offer: This is a bit more involved than the last request, we recently lost a scavenger party coming to trade with us and would like you to investigate.  We strongly suspect a raider band or horde caught them off-guard.  I can give you the coordinates of their last radio message but little else.  In either case, deal with the threat so that the scavengers can continue to pass through in relative safety.  The best reward I can offer is a claim to the supplies they were carrying, plus thirty certified notes - that's our own internal money, good for trading and such.
dialogue.accepted: Our community survives on trade, we appreciate it.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: If you can, get a friend or two to help you.
dialogue.success: Thank you, the world is a better place without them.  Two of our more skilled individuals accepted the assistance of the Old Guard in setting up an outpost while you were out.  We didn't have many other options, refugees are still streaming in and we don't know what else to do with our limited food supply.  If you get a chance, you should see if they need your assistance in the future…
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_3.name: Retrieve Prospectus
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_3.description: Visit the farming commune and bring the foreman's prospectus back to the refugee center, for <reward_count:FMCNote> certified notes.

dialogue.offer: We recently set out some skilled people to start an outpost, to secure us some food supplies in a safer location.  The new outpost that we've started could use your assistance.  I need you to get the foreman's prospectus before we begin to send additional refugees to the farming commune.  Consult with the foreman to get more detailed tasks.  We've got 50 Certified Notes for you if you can do this for us.
dialogue.accepted: I'm sure the outpost will expand quickly with your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: Just follow your map.
dialogue.success: With this we'll be able to convince others to invest in the commune.  Thank you, here's your money.  We also managed to get a manual crank hooked up to the garage in the back, so feel free to make use of that - you've been a great help to us.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_4.name: Solar Power
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_4.description: Deliver 10 solar panel arrays to help the Free Merchants set up a renewable power grid, in exchange for a handsome reward.

dialogue.offer: We are starting to build new infrastructure here and would like to get a few new electrical systems online… unfortunately our existing system relies on an array of something called RTGs.  Running generators isn't a viable option underground, of course.  We have a big flat roof up top, and if we had a few solar panel arrays we could use them to top up our usage.  We could pay you pretty handsomely to bring us, say, ten solar panel arrays?  If you find any advanced solar panels, those are even better.
dialogue.accepted: If you can do this for us our survival options would vastly increase.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: Solar panel arrays are pretty common on solar farms and on rooftops.  Each advanced solar panel array is worth two solar panel array.
dialogue.success: Great, I know it isn't much but we hope to continue to expand thanks to your help.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_5.name: In a Pickle
MISSION_FREE_MERCHANTS_EVAC_5.description: Deliver 100 0.5 L glass jars to the Free Merchants to kickstart their food storage plans.

dialogue.offer: While we've managed to secure day to day food supplies, it's very much hand to mouth.  Our reserves would barely last a few days if something kept our people locked in.  We need a stockpile to avoid that.  Thanks to our outpost we have a bit of meat and vegetables coming in, but we need a better way to preserve them.  Some of our people know enough about food canning that if we had a good stock of canning jars, we could make pickles and canned meats to get us set for the winter.  I'll pay you a premium rate if you can bring us around a hundred jars to get us started.
dialogue.accepted: It'll take a load off my shoulders if I can finally stop worrying about this.
dialogue.rejected: We'll hold for the moment, but I'll get an ulcer if I have to keep worrying.  If you reconsider let me know.
dialogue.advice: Grocery stores, house kitchens, there's plenty of places to look.
dialogue.success: That's one less thing to worry about.  Glad to have someone like you on our side.  Here's 25 merch, and the broker will buy any further glass jars you can find - at a reduced price, we can't keep up the premium rate.  Actually, the broker was saying they had some jobs like this for you, and that it might be easier to just go straight through their office if you want more work.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_ARSONIST_1_AMMONIUM_NITRATE.name: Supply the arsonist
MISSION_ARSONIST_1_AMMONIUM_NITRATE.description: Bring the arsonist 120 units of commercial fertilizer.

dialogue.describe: I could use some help getting some materials.
dialogue.offer: I could use some help getting some materials.  Molotovs are nice for burning down buildings but aren't all that for keeping yourself safe.  If you could get me 120 units of commercial fertilizer I could make something a lot more potent.
dialogue.accepted: Oh man, thanks so much friend.  You won't regret it.
dialogue.rejected: Think it over.
dialogue.advice: Commercial fertilizer tends to be made from ammonium nitrate, which is also usable as an explosive.  Try looking for some around the abandoned farms.
dialogue.inquire: Did you find any fertilizer?  Are you sure this is the ammonium nitrate kind?
dialogue.success: This is great!  I'll get to work making something of this.  You can have some of my Molotovs, I won't need quite so many now.
dialogue.success_lie: I guess I could convince the shelter to sell me some.
dialogue.failure: Damn.  Perhaps I wasn't the only one who thought of this.

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_1.name: Kill Bandits
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_1.description: A pair of bandits have been preying on locals, based out of a nearby cabin.  Ensure they meet a bitter end along with any associates, but watch out for traps around their hideout.

dialogue.offer: I don't like sending untested men into the field but if you have stayed alive so far you might have some skills.  There are at least a pair of bandits squatting in a local cabin, anyone who preys upon civilians meets a quick end… execute both of them for their crimes.  Complete this and the Old Guard will consider you an asset in the region.
dialogue.accepted: Contractor, I welcome you aboard.
dialogue.rejected: The States will remain a wasteland unless good men choose to save it.
dialogue.advice: They might suspect you are coming, keep an eye out for traps.
dialogue.success: The Old Guard thanks you for eliminating the criminals.  You won't be forgotten.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_2.name: Deal with Informant
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_2.description: The Hell's Raiders bandit group may have an informant working inside the Refugee Center.  Investigate and bring them to justice without arousing any suspicions.

dialogue.offer: This task is going to require a little more persuasive skill.  I believe the Hell's Raiders have an informant here to monitor who comes and goes.  I need you to find out who it is and deal with them without letting anyone else know of my suspicions.  We normally allow the Free Merchants to govern themselves so I would hate to offend them.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you, please keep this discreet.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we could use a few good men.
dialogue.advice: If they draw first blood their friends are less likely to blame you…
dialogue.success: Thank you, I'll do the explaining if anyone else asks about it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_3.name: Find Source of Robots
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_3.description: Go to the supposed source of the weird robots marked on your map and report back to the Old Guard representative what you've seen.

dialogue.describe: Got a weird one for you this time…
dialogue.offer: I don't usually hear much from command, but we got a message by radio recently.  You might be the right choice to look into it for me.  There've been reports of weird robots and things wandering around since things went south.  Dunno how, but apparently command tracked down what they think is the source.  They want someone to go check out who is making these, and if we can get any tech or assistance from them.  This is strictly recon, you understand: could be a hostile entity, so do not engage directly.  Report back to me when you've found out something.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, once you know who it is, report back to me and I'll pass that on.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, if there's any chance these things are on our side, we need all the help we can get.
dialogue.advice: If you see any weird machines around, do not engage.  Sneak away, I'd say.  They seem to be hostile to zombies, but that doesn't mean they can tell you aren't one.
dialogue.success: Great work, wasn't sure what I was sending you after.
dialogue.success_lie: That's a shame, a damn shame.  Wish you could have learned more.  Thanks for trying.
dialogue.failure: Damn… let's hope we can try again sometime.

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_4.name: Secure Trade Route
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_4.description: One of the Free Merchants silently disappeared while escorting a trade caravan.  Whoever or whatever is responsible must be quick and quiet - investigate the trade route and eliminate the threat.

dialogue.offer: There is another monster troubling the merchants but this time it isn't human… at least I don't think.  Guy just disappeared while walking behind a packed caravan.  They didn't hear any shots but I suppose some raider may have been real sneaky.  Check out the area and report anything you find.
dialogue.accepted: Thanks, keeping the people safe is what we try and do.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we really need to start reclaiming the region.
dialogue.advice: Search the bushes for any trace?  I'm not an expert tracker but you should be able to find something.
dialogue.success: Great work, wasn't sure what I was sending you after.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_5.name: Assassinate Raider Leader
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REP_5.description: The Old Guard have located a Hell's Raiders encampment that is coordinating attacks on the Free Merchants.  Pay them a visit and execute the area leadership.

dialogue.offer: I've located a Hell's Raiders encampment in the region that appears to be coordinating operations against the Free Merchants.  We know almost nothing about the command structure in the 'gang' so I need to send someone in to decapitate the leadership.  The raid will be held under orders of the U.S. Marshals Service and by agreeing to the mission you will become a marshal, swearing to assist the federal government in regaining order.
dialogue.accepted: Now repeat after me… I do solemnly swear that I will support and defend the Constitution of the United States against all enemies, foreign and domestic… that I will bear true faith and allegiance to the same… that I take this obligation freely, without any mental reservation or purpose of evasion… and that I will well and faithfully discharge the duties of the office on which I am about to enter.  To establish justice, insure domestic tranquility, provide for the common defense, promote the general welfare and secure the blessings of liberty.  So help me God.  Congratulations Marshal, don't forget your badge and gun.  As a marshal all men or women assisting you are considered deputy marshals so keep them in line.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance, we could use a few good men.
dialogue.advice: I'd recommend having two deputies… it would be a death trap if a single man got surrounded.
dialogue.inquire: Has the leadership been dealt with?
dialogue.success: Marshal, you continue to impress us.  We may have some hope of long term survival yet thanks to you.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REPEATER_BEGIN.name: Install radio repeater mod
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REPEATER_BEGIN.description: The Old Guard wishes to expand their range of communications to get in touch with other survivors in the Wasteland.  Find a Radio Station and install a repeater mod via its terminal.

dialogue.describe: I don't need anything major for now, Marshal.  Well, except…
dialogue.offer: For now, the perimeter of the Refugee Center is free of threats.  That means we can afford to divert our attention to others in need of help.  However, our communication with the wasteland is lacking at best and nonexistent at worst.  We need to broaden our reach to intercept and send radio broadcasts.  Unfortunately Radio Towers are out of the question to widen our broadcasts, as the emergency grid for them is out of action.  However, Radio Stations in towns or urban areas should still have some juice left.  I want you to install something called a "radio repeater mod" in these stations that can broaden their reach and allow them to pick weaker signals.  Sadly, I have neither these devices nor a manual for them at my disposal.  You'll need to find instructions and assemble them yourself.  Are you up for this task?
dialogue.accepted: As I said, I have no repeaters or manuals at my disposal.  But you might want to try you chances in Libraries or maybe other survivors.  Godspeed, Marshal.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance Marshal.  We really need get in touch with rest of the region.
dialogue.advice: As I recommended, libraries would be a good start.  Or any place that sells books and manuals, really.
dialogue.inquire: Have you set up a repeater yet, Marshal?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the good work, Marshal.  It's not much but please accept these supplies to compensate.  Come back to me if you are willing to install more.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh; that's weird, the boys at comms say that they didn't really see an improvement.  Well, if you want to try again, come to me.  Maybe this time it'll work.
dialogue.failure: That's a damn shame…  You can come back anytime if you want to try again.

MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REPEATER.name: Install radio repeater mod
MISSION_OLD_GUARD_REPEATER.description: The Old Guard wishes to expand their range of communications to get in touch with other survivors in the Wasteland.  Find a Radio Station and install a repeater mod via its terminal.

dialogue.offer: We need more repeaters to expand our range and ability of our communications.  You know the drill Marshal, find or assemble a radio repeater mod and set it up in a Radio Station.  Radio Towers are still off the table.
dialogue.accepted: Stay safe, Marshal.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance Marshal.  We really need get in touch with rest of the region.
dialogue.advice: You can find the Radio Stations in towns or urban centers.  I still have no repeater mod available Marshal.  However you can craft one yourself, if you find the manual.  Try libraries or bookstores if you still don't have one.
dialogue.inquire: Have you set up a repeater yet, Marshal?
dialogue.success: Good work, Marshal.  Here's some supplies for your next venture.  Come back to me if you are willing to install more.
dialogue.success_lie: Huh, that's weird, the boys at comms say that they didn't really see an improvement.  Well, if you want to try again, come to me.  Maybe this time it'll work.
dialogue.failure: Oh well, you can try again anytime.

MISSION_FIND_SUNKEN_HELICOPTER.name: Find the sunken helicopter
MISSION_FIND_SUNKEN_HELICOPTER.description: You got the location of a sunken helicopter, all that's left to do is find a way to get there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_MERC_1_RADIO.name: Active Noise Control
MISSION_ROBOFAC_MERC_1_RADIO.description: Investigate Hub 01's radio tower, discover the source of the interference, and fix the problem.

dialogue.offer: Well… a little while ago, I set up a radio transmitter in the radio tower not far from here, but it stopped transmitting.  I went over there and encountered some crazy stuff you wouldn't believe if you didn't see it yourself:  Some 'plants' moving around, replicating, and attacking me with lightning bolts.  Luckily, the environmental suit I've got from our employers protected me from damage, but fried my electronics.  If you're willing to back me up to eradicate them, I'll owe you a favor.  However, I suggest you turn the mission down and come back when you think you've got sufficient gear.
dialogue.accepted: Alright, let's be off, if you think you've got sufficient gear.  You don't mind taking point, right?
dialogue.rejected: Well, thanks for offering.  I hope you'll be able to come back when you've gotten hold of protective gear.
dialogue.advice: Get hold of an environmental suit of your own, unless you've got some other protection against electric shocks.  Bring a good weapon and some ammo as well; no idea what insanity <the_cataclysm> has brought us this time, beyond what I saw during my brief encounter.
dialogue.inquire: You think we fixed the problem?
dialogue.success: Sure seems like it.  What even was that…?  Eh, doesn't matter.  Let's go back to the Hub; hopefully the tower's working now.
dialogue.success_lie: *frowns at you.  "I've been with you this whole time, dude.  C'mon.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_MERC_1_RETURN_TO_HUB.name: Return to Hub 01
MISSION_ROBOFAC_MERC_1_RETURN_TO_HUB.description: With the source of the radio tower's interference fixed, return to Hub 01 with Cranberry.

dialogue.offer: Let's get back home.
dialogue.accepted: Alright, let's be off.  You don't mind taking point, right?
dialogue.advice: Hey, you have a map, don't you?  You can use mine, if you need.
dialogue.success: Thanks a lot for having my back.  Like I said, I owe you one.

BEM_human_sample_mission.name: Fleshmonger
BEM_human_sample_mission.description: Deposit a human sample in a pit within the dead drop location.  Pick up your reward at the Terminal once that's done.

BEM_jabberwock_mission.name: "God"-Slayer
BEM_jabberwock_mission.description: A traumatized mercenary has claimed to have seen what you assume to be a powerful monster.  Maybe you should investigate this for the benefit of everyone.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_1.name: Find smokes for Pat
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_1.description: I met a fellow Hub mercenary named Pat.  They asked me to keep an eye out for two cigarettes - normal kind.  If I find them, I should take the cigs back to Pat.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_2.name: Find gear for Pat
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_2.description: Pat and I seem to be getting along well, and they want to start working together as partners.  I should find <color_yellow>1 pair of advanced AR glasses</color>, <color_yellow>2 two-way radios</color>, and <color_yellow>2 e-ink tablet PCs</color> for Pat, and they'll make a pair of glasses so they can assist me in the field.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_FIAH_POWAH.name: Fiah-Powah
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_FIAH_POWAH.description: Pat knew about a military outpost near their cousin's place.  Maybe I can get some fire power there to help take the bandits Smokes is having trouble with.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_GROCERY.name: Supah-Mahket
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_GROCERY.description: Pat sent me to their favorite supermarket.  Maybe they'll have all the jars Smokes needs?

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_CONTAINAH.name: Cousin's Fathah's Containahs
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_CONTAINAH.description: Pat said that maybe a nearby container yard has cigs.  I guess I could check it out?

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_OUTTA_TOWN.name: Outta Town Fahm Supply
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_OUTTA_TOWN.description: Pat said that maybe I can find fertilizer at a farm supply store.  I guess I could check it out?

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_HOSPITAL.name: The hospital, ya' stunad
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_HOSPITAL.description: Pat said that maybe I can find anesthetic for Rubik at a hospital.  Naturally.  I guess I could check it out?

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_EXODII_WAREHOUSE.name: Pat & the Lost Warehouse
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_EXODII_WAREHOUSE.description: Pat is looking into Rubik's lost warehouse for me.  They said it could take a while, and told me to check in once a week.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_LUMBERMILL.name: A lumbahmill
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_LUMBERMILL.description: Pat gave me directions to a lumbermill to get supplies for the traders.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_1.name: Pat's Recon: The Farmstead
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_1.description: Pat directed me to a strange farmstead, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_2.name: Pat's Recon: DOE Building
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_2.description: Pat directed me to a building owned by the Department of Energy, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_3.name: Pat's Recon: The Grate
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_3.description: Pat directed me to a strange grate in the wilderness, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_4.name: Pat's Recon: The Mine
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_4.description: Pat directed me to a mine, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_5.name: Pat's Recon: The Castle
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_5.description: Pat directed me to a strange castle made of scrap metal, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_7.name: Pat's Recon: The Meat
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_7.description: Pat directed me to what appears to be a hunk of meat, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_8.name: Pat's Recon: The Glow
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_8.description: Pat directed me to the location of a glowing building, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_9.name: Pat's Recon: The Fence
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_9.description: Pat directed me to a fence where a merc reported odd creatures, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_10.name: Pat's Recon: The Cabin
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_10.description: Pat directed me to a cabin, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_11.name: Pat's Recon: The Sound
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_11.description: Pat directed me to a radio tower, thinking there may be something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_12.name: Pat's Recon: Spirals
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_12.description: Pat learned about a mine filled with 'spirals,' and thinks there is something interesting there.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_13.name: Pat's Recon: the Scarlet Storm
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_RECON_13.description: Pat learned about some sort of storm.  It seems pretty dangerous, but might be worth checking out.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_CIRCUIT_SAFARI_RECON.name: Circuit Safari: Pat's Recon
MISSION_ROBOFAC_PAT_CIRCUIT_SAFARI_RECON.description: Pat talked to a guy who heard about a guy who saw an Exodii that looked like his friend.  If you're lucky, it'll be a worker you can kill and bring back to Hub 01.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_1.name: Return Field Data
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_1.description: Investigate a nearby field and return with Dr. Prado and the robot prototype she was testing.  Failing that, retrieve the I/O recorder stored within the robot.  If the robot remains operational, avoid direct confrontation and use EMP grenades to disable it.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_2.name: Return to sender
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_2.description: Find the corpse of a Hub 01's AI researcher and retrieve the hard case they brought with them during the evacuation.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_3.name: Light retrieval
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_3.description: Reach the collapsed tower basement, and search the ruins for a photonic circuitry template.  The intercom warned you about heavy enemy presence, and of the existence of a hazardous environment.  They aren't sure if the safety gear they gave you is enough.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_ROBOT_SM_1.name: Iron Safari
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_ROBOT_SM_1.description: Disable and retrieve the unusual robot by <color_yellow>successfully stunning it with the prototype rifle provided,</color> then <color_yellow>quickly running up and deactivating the robot before it recovers from the stun</color>.  You can keep shooting it while it's stunned to prolong the time until it is active again.  You can intercept the robot indicated by Hub 01, or find an inactive robot somewhere else.  <color_yellow>You'll need to read the 'trifacet handling procedures' manual before trying to deactivate it</color>.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_PORTAL_SM_1.name: Hazard Meteorology
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_PORTAL_SM_1.description: Use the NRE recorder to collect information during a portal storm event.  You'll need to <color_yellow>stay outside and carry the recorder for around 6 minutes until you hear a sharp beep</color> to collect sufficient data.  Generate a printout by activating the NRE recorder and offer it to Hub 01 to finish the mission.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_LIXA_SM_1.name: Data Retrieval
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_LIXA_SM_1.description: Reach the LIXA facility, and search the area for anything of interest.  The intercom warned you about a number of undead aboveground, and the high probability of more underground.

MISSION_HUB01_PAY_BACK_RIOT_GEAR.name: Pay Back The Riot Gear to Hub 01
MISSION_HUB01_PAY_BACK_RIOT_GEAR.name_plural: Pay Back The Riot Gear to Hub 01s

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_1.name: Weather Permitting
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_1.description: Assemble and <color_yellow>activate the 1-hour recording subroutine</color> on a <color_yellow>mobile weather station</color> during an <color_yellow>early</color>, <color_yellow>distant</color>, or <color_yellow>close portal storm</color>.  After 1 hour the station will print some sort of <color_yellow>strange weather datasheet</color> to return to Hub 01.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_2.name: System Retrieval
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_2.description: Travel to the DARPA research station and find the <color_yellow>mobile hazardous environment weather station</color>.  Should I bring a swimsuit?

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_3.name: Storm Chaser
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_3.description: Take the <color_yellow>mobile hazardous environment weather station</color> into an <color_yellow>early</color>, <color_yellow>distant</color>, or <color_yellow>close portal storm</color>, assemble it, and start a recording.  Return the resulting <color_yellow>HEW anomalous weather printout</color> to Hub 01.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_4.name: True Weatherperson
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_4.description: Record "atmospheric" data return a HEW datasheet to Hub 01.  They recommend scanning with the HEW system anywhere there is, or was, portal activity.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_MONSTER_COR.name: Invasive "Meteorology"
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_MONSTER_COR.description: Go to the <color_yellow>exact underground coordinates</color>, set up a HEW station, and make a recording.  Return the <color_yellow>alien "atmospheric" datasheet</color> to Hub 01.  You may wish to rendezvous with the advanced field team, if you can find them.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_MONSTER_COR.name: Invasive "Meteorology:" contact the field team
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_MWS_MONSTER_COR.description: A team of Hub 01 contractors is at work near the organic mass.  I can check in with them if I want to, but it isn't essential to my mission.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_IVAS.name: Augmented Reality
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_IVAS.description: The intercom has asked me to retrieve something called a <color_yellow>Military Visual Augmentation System</color>, which looks like a VR headset.  They're sending me to an in-town office to fetch it.  Use the <color_yellow>ID card</color> to gain access.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_CHOP_SHOP.name: Post-Apocalyptic IRB
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_CHOP_SHOP.description: The intercom has asked me to <color_yellow>kill a rogue scientist named Dr. Harlow</color>, who they say is performing unethical experiments on live humans.  I am also authorized to use lethal force against anyone who resists, and to pillage the site.

MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_CIRCUIT_SAFARI.name: Circuit Safari
MISSION_ROBOFAC_INTERCOM_CIRCUIT_SAFARI.description: The intercom has asked me to bring them the remains of an <color_yellow>Exodii worker</color>.  They said I can use any violent means necessary to take it down.

MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_25_MAGNETRON.name: Find 25 Magnetrons
MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_25_MAGNETRON.description: Obtain 25 magnetrons in exchange for credit with the scrap merchant.

dialogue.offer: Since business is increasing around here, I've decided to start selling more specialized metal.  Problem is, I can't separate the metal out.  Fortunately, I found some old schematics on a machine for this sort of thing.  If you could get me 25 magnetrons, I can melt down the sorted stuff into bars.  I can quickly pay you in raw materials.
dialogue.advice: Magnetrons can be found in microwaves.  An apartment block should have tons of them.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  I'll start the smelting as soon as possible.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll do it myself.

MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_75_CHARCOAL.name: Obtain 300 Charcoal
MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_75_CHARCOAL.description: Obtain 300 lumps of charcoal in exchange for credit with the scrap merchant.

dialogue.offer: That machine I put together is working wonderfully, but the generator is nearly out of juice.  If you could get me 300 lumps of charcoal, I'll pay you however I can.
dialogue.advice: Its fairly simple to make some.  I don't know where you could find any, though.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  This should do for a while.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll do it myself.

MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_100_SOLDER.name: Obtain 100 Solder
MISSION_SCRAP_TRADER_GET_100_SOLDER.description: Obtain 100 solder in exchange for credit with the scrap merchant.

dialogue.offer: That machine I put together needs some repairs on it, but I'm out of solder.  If you could get me about 100 spools, I'll pay you for it.
dialogue.advice: An electronics store might have some.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Someone's got to do it.
dialogue.success: Wonderful!  This should do for a while.
dialogue.success_lie: Where are they?  I don't believe you.
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess I'll do it myself.

MISSION_SCRAPPER_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.name: Establish A Trade Route
MISSION_SCRAPPER_SET_TRADE_ROUTE.description: Establish trade relations between the scrapper and a refugee center, and bring back a writ of the agreement.

dialogue.offer: I was out scavenging recently, and I found one of those old evac shelters.  Turns out the computer was still on and had an address for a refugee center.  I figure they might want some spare metal, so I need you to go over there and strike a deal with them.
dialogue.advice: It should be pretty simple making the deal, but I'd recommend taking a car over there myself.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Please?  This is really important to me.
dialogue.inquire: What did they say about it?
dialogue.success: Thank you!
dialogue.success_lie: How does this help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to trade with.

MISSION_SCRAPPER_SET_TRADE_ROUTE_BLACKSM.name: Establish A Trade Route
MISSION_SCRAPPER_SET_TRADE_ROUTE_BLACKSM.description: Establish trade relations between the scrapper and some artisans.

dialogue.offer: Business has been booming since you made a deal with that refugee center.  The last caravan that came by here mentioned something about a blacksmith down some old road.  Sounds like another business opportunity, so I need you to go over there and make a deal.
dialogue.advice: It should be pretty simple making the contract, but I'd recommend taking a car over there myself.
dialogue.accepted: I'll be here when you get back.  Good luck!
dialogue.rejected: Please?  This is really important to me.
dialogue.inquire: What did they say about the agreement?
dialogue.success: Thank you!
dialogue.success_lie: How does this help us?
dialogue.failure: That's unfortunate.  I guess we'll have to find someone else to trade with.

dialogue.offer: The wine and beer we can brew are sufficient to attract most patrons, but we need something a bit stronger to get them to forget their misery.  Could you build me a pair of stills?
dialogue.accepted: This should let us start producing whiskey, rum, and brandy when we get access to the ingredients.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: I'm sure you could find the design for the stills in home brewing books.
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The last batch that I brewed was terrible, I'm fairly sure something contaminated the yeast we have been using.  Could you locate a source of fresh yeast for us to use?  I'd need about 20 teaspoons of dry yeast to get started.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Yeast should be common in homes or bakeries.
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Sugar and molasses remains in short supply.  I've put in a request for more, but it is unlikely that I'm going to see a reliable source for some time.  If you are interested, we are going to need sugar beet seeds to meet future demand regardless of what the scavengers can find.  Could you bring me at least enough seeds to plant a small 10 meter long patch?
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Farms or supply stores might have a few seeds…
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the sugar beet seeds?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The drinks we brew here have become a major draw for visitors and the occasional trader.  Our batches have become larger, but we are still running out of storage space between trading runs.  I've been able to get a few volunteers to help me build a set of standing tanks, but I still need 12 60-liter metal tanks to build them.  I've talked with the scrappers, but we are a low priority at the moment.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Scrapping vehicles might be your best bet.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the 60-liter metal tanks?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The other survivor outposts that we have contact with have been more than eager to trade for beer or other drinks.  Transporting the drinks to them has presented a number of challenges though.  If you could locate a pair of 200-liter drums, we should be able to keep them supplied while turning a significant profit.
dialogue.accepted: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Factories or junk yards are the only places I know where to look.
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_RANCH_DOCTOR_SUPPLIES.name: Collect Office Supplies
MISSION_RANCH_DOCTOR_SUPPLIES.description: The doctor needs office supplies to keep track of medical records.  Bring them 10 Book binders and 500 paper.

dialogue.inquire: Have you found the supplies yet?
dialogue.success: Thanks!  This should help keep things organized for a while.

dialogue.offer: One of the laborers injured their foot pretty badly and I don't want them walking on it for a few days at least.  Do you think you could find a pair of crutches?
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You might be able to find some in hospitals, but some makeshift crutches would be better than nothing.
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_RANCH_DOCTOR_MEDICAL_GLOVES.name: Find 5 Pairs of Medical Gloves
MISSION_RANCH_DOCTOR_MEDICAL_GLOVES.description: Bring the doctor 5 pairs of medical gloves.

dialogue.offer: We're getting a lot of scrapes and bruises coming in right now, but it's only a matter of time before we see a serious injury.  I'm not prepared for when that happens and I'm hoping you can help.  To start off, I'm going to need some more medical gloves to help prevent infections.  Can you bring me 5 pairs?
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Hospitals or clinics might have a few sitting around.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the medical gloves?
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_RANCH_DOCTOR_MEDICAL_ANESTHETIC.name: Anesthetic for the Doctor
MISSION_RANCH_DOCTOR_MEDICAL_ANESTHETIC.description: Bring the doctor 3000 units of anesthetic.  Ask around the commune for assistance in building an anesthetic machine.

dialogue.offer: I want to make sure we are setup to handle any major surgeries that come our way, but pain management is going to be an issue.  For longer surgeries, we're going to need some anesthetic.  Can you bring me 3000 units to start?  We're also going to need an anesthetic machine to deliver it.  Maybe some people around the commune can help with that?
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Hospitals or clinics might have some.  Labs could have some as well.
dialogue.inquire: Any progress on getting some anesthetic or parts?
dialogue.success: The scavengers found more medical equipment than I expected and with the help from the scrappers, I've been able to get most of it up and running.  I should be able to perform more operations now.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Our first project is to enclose the barn so that new refugees have a safe place to sleep.  Before we can begin serious improvements, we need lumber to work with.  Enclosing the four barn entrances will take nearly 400 planks… if you could provide half of that, we should be able to take care of the other half and construction.  If you don't have a truck, I'd make finding one your first priority.
dialogue.accepted: The more men we can bring to the camp, the quicker improvements can be made.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: Great, I'll send word that we could use another set of hands or two to help out here.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: With the barn entrances enclosed, the refugees moving in there should feel safer, but the weather can be bitter here.  We're going to need to build makeshift beds in the stalls to ward off disease and frostbite.  We can take care of the frames, but will need your help looting blankets.  We'd need 25 blankets to provide the most basic sleeping accommodations.
dialogue.accepted: I'd start with looting hotels or you could sew them together… but that would be a last resort.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture here, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: Your assistance is always appreciated.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Our supply of nails has been depleted.  I'm going to have to ask you to get us a few more boxes.  Hardware stores should have a few if they haven't been looted.  I suppose you may be able to find handfuls of them in building rubble.  We'd need 2500 to have enough that we won't be sending you back out too soon.
dialogue.accepted: Deconstructing furniture isn't going to be efficient, try looking for boxes or grabbing any sitting on top of rubble piles.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Avoid destroying the furniture here, we'll be needing it.
dialogue.success: Your assistance is always appreciated.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I'm sure you've noticed the new workers that have started trickling in.  The Free Merchant counsel is demanding that we immediately begin projects to become self-sufficient due to limited supplies.  We are going to need to rapidly setup an agricultural industry before winter and starvation catches us unprepared and unsupported.  In order to get a half dozen shovels and a couple of bags of seeds, we are going to have to trade for it.  I've already got the deal lined up, but the only thing they are willing to trade it for is salt.  I negotiated them down from 50 lbs to 30… we were hoping you might have access to a source.
dialogue.accepted: Salt is key to preserving meat and other perishables… without any excess food it wouldn't do us much good now, but I imagine we'll need to send you out to get more in the future.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: If you can find a source of salt water you should be able to boil it down.  Alternatively, you can go into the cities and search restaurants.
dialogue.success: We are going to begin preparing our fields immediately.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_RANCH_FOREMAN_5.name: Gather 30 Bottles (120 units) of Liquid Fertilizer
MISSION_RANCH_FOREMAN_5.name_plural: Gather 30 Bottles (120 units) of Liquid Fertilizers

dialogue.offer: Well, our first crop will be planted shortly, but I'm starting to suspect that our profit margin is going to be much smaller than we expect.  With limited seed for our original crop, our next course of action is to increase the soil's fertility.  Is there any way you could find or produce a basic liquid fertilizer for us?  We'd need at least 120 units or 30 full bottles to make a significant improvement in our output.
dialogue.accepted: I don't know the exact recipe, but I'm sure you could make it from a commercial fertilizer or produce it from bonemeal.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: I'd look through a few basic chemistry books to find a simple recipe.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the liquid fertilizer?
dialogue.success: This really should make the first winter easier to survive.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Our current assessment for survivability has increased significantly thanks to your efforts.  The next priority issue is securing a cleaner water source.  Drinking from the pond on the back end of the ranch has led to an outbreak of dysentery.  We need to improve the sanitary conditions in the camp as quickly as possible.  To do so, the first step is to dig a well and construct stone fireplaces in the barn for the migrants to boil water.  We are going to need at least 75 rocks from you if we hope to accomplish the task before we all get sick.  After we have them installed, you will have free access to them, guaranteed.
dialogue.accepted: If you take a shovel to a pile of rubble, you should be able to pull out structural grade rocks.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Mining would always be an option if you had the resources.
dialogue.success: I appreciate the work you do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: To fabricate the well's hand pump and construct components for several other projects, we are going to need to find or fabricate a number of steel pipes.  Plumbing is a distant possibility for now, but some form of irrigation will eventually become desirable.  You could assist us with procuring 50 steel pipes, if you so have the chance.
dialogue.accepted: Hopefully we will be able to assign new migrants to help fulfill our needs in the future.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Pipes are used in numerous metal constructions.  Smashing abandoned furniture may provide the material we need.
dialogue.success: I appreciate the work you do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: With the well's completion, we are rapidly closing the sustainability gap.  In order to expand from here, we will need massive quantities of lumber to construct fortifications and new buildings.  We have already begun work on a manually operated sawmill, but we will need two electric motors to control the actual blades.  We were hoping you might be able to secure the motors for us.
dialogue.accepted: Power for the motors will be provided by a salvaged truck battery, you need not bring additional mechanical components.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: A car dealership or a golf course might have some electric vehicles to get one from.  Otherwise there's probably something broken down along the road.
dialogue.success: I appreciate the work you do.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Disease and infection remains a persistent problem among the refugees.  Without dedicated medical personnel and facilities, I doubt everyone will be willing to stick around when the next outbreak happens.  Until we can get a former medic or nurse, I'm just going to have to improvise.  Sterilization would be the first step I imagine.  Bring me 150 units of bleach so we can get started.
dialogue.accepted: I'm sure you can find bleach in most homes…
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: If you can't find a large supply I'd recommend checking hospitals or research labs.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: We've started planning a medical clinic, but we are going to need a lot more supplies if we hope to warrant sending one of the few people with medical experience from the refugee center to our outpost.  I know first aid equipment is rare, but they have all the basic supplies that I'm uncertain of.  If you could bring in thirty-six bandages I'm sure we could supplement them to make theirs last a bit longer.
dialogue.accepted: We'll do our best to make them last…
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Homes, hospitals, labs, and doctor offices would be where I'd check.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: We've started planning a medical clinic, but we are going to need a lot more supplies if we hope to warrant sending one of the few people with medical experience from the refugee center to our outpost.  I know first aid equipment is rare, but they have all the basic supplies that I'm uncertain of.  If you could bring in 6 bottles of antiseptic, I'm sure we could supplement them to make theirs last a bit longer.
dialogue.accepted: We'll do our best to make them last…
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Homes, hospitals, labs, and doctor offices would be where I'd check.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The work you have done has swayed the leaders at the refugee center to send someone out to assist with our medical needs.  The next step is for us to get a sort of chop-shop setup so that we can begin using scrap metal to build fortifications and equipment.  We are going to need a pair of arc welders for our mechanics to use.
dialogue.accepted: With two, we should be able to repair one if it breaks.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: The only place I've seen them is garages, but I imagine you could find them in some stores.
dialogue.success: I appreciate it.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: We have the basic equipment that we need, but without a functioning power grid, we are forced to rely on the readily available vehicle batteries.  This is going to be a chore, but I'll need twelve car batteries to swap between charging and powering our equipment.  The good news is that they don't need to be charged; we can take care of that.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Cars can be found in traffic jams along roads or in parking lots… I'm sure you can find a few.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the car batteries?
dialogue.success: I'm impressed with your abilities.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Check with the nurse when you get a chance; I know she will need help setting up our clinic.  On the construction front, we are going to need to get dedicated scavenger teams setup to bring in the miscellaneous supplies that we use in small quantities.  We are going to start setting up a junk shop for them behind the sawmill, so we could use your help with that.  Communication is the biggest obstacle for the teams… could you bring in a pair of two-way radios?
dialogue.accepted: Organizing the scavenging missions is difficult enough without communication.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You should be able to find them in electronics stores or at a police station.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the two-way radios?
dialogue.success: I'm sure the scavengers will find these useful.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The volunteers for the scavenging teams will need to be issued some basic equipment.  When the boss sets up shop in the junk shed, you should ask him what else he needs for his teams.  In the meantime, we can provide a few backpacks to get them started.  Could you find five backpacks to give to the initial team?
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: It may be easier to make them if you can't find a school or something.
dialogue.success: Having at least basic equipment greatly increases survivability.  Thanks.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

MISSION_RANCH_FOREMAN_15.name: Find a copy of Homebrewer's Bible
MISSION_RANCH_FOREMAN_15.name_plural: Find a copy of Homebrewer's Bibles

dialogue.offer: Growth has lately begun to stall.  We have individuals passing through the outpost, but the prospect of hard labor just to eke out an existence is driving them away.  We've asked around and decided that, despite our pressing needs, building a bar ought to draw some of the less committed individuals to the outpost.  Unlike other settlements, the more hands we have, the more food we can produce… at least in the long term.  Unfortunately, no one here has brewed alcoholic drinks before, so we are going to need you to find a book called the 'Homebrewer's Bible' or something along those lines.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: I guess you should search homes or libraries?
dialogue.success: I guarantee we will toast to your name when the bar is finished.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Just flipping through the book, I can tell that one ingredient in most of the alcoholic drinks that we don't have a large supply of is sugar.  What alcohol we have been able to loot isn't going to last us long, so starting our first large batch is a priority.  Could you bring in 110 lbs of sugar?  That should last us until we can start producing our own supply.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You might get lucky finding it, but you could always boil it out of fruit if you are familiar with the process.  Or go into the cities and look in restaurants and bakeries.
dialogue.success: There is a large group of thirsty individuals in our outpost that are truly thankful for your work.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Although we are an agricultural outpost, we are restricted to growing plants that are compatible with the New England climate during the warmer months.  The easiest way to work around that is to build greenhouses to supplement our external fields.  There isn't going to be an easy way to build these.  We are going to need a massive number of glass sheets to enclose the frames.  The first house will need 30 sheets of glass if you are still interested.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Deconstructing existing windows is the only way I know of to keep the sheets intact.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the glass sheets?
dialogue.success: We'll begin planting our first seeds as soon as we can get these installed.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I've got a handful of bandages and a few first aid kits to work with at the moment… in other words I'm completely unable to treat most serious medical emergencies.  I'm supposed to have priority on any medical supplies that the scavengers bring in, but I imagine the black market for the stuff will prevent me from ever seeing it.  I could use your help getting me 100 aspirin pills to start with.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Aspirin is pretty common in homes and convenience stores.
dialogue.success: We'll go through this pretty quickly, but it does help.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I was given a few bottles of bleach when I arrived, but I need a number of hotplates to actually sterilize equipment.  I'm sure you can find them in any old house or appliance store.  Three should be enough for now.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: It should be a fairly common item.  Don't know what else to say.
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Disease is spreading rapidly due to poor nutrition and there is little that I can do about it.  With food being scarce, people are willing to survive on whatever they can.  I need to start supplementing the outpost's diet with vitamins to prevent potential deaths indirectly attributable to nutrition.  I know it is a lot, but if you could bring me 200 multivitamin pills, I'd be able to treat the most vulnerable before they spread anything to the rest of us.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: It should be a fairly common item.  Don't know what else to say.
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Despite my recommendations, we continue to have travelers come in with illnesses that I've been able to trace back to contaminated drinking water.  When boiling water isn't an option, they need some form of charcoal water filter that they can use.  If you could build me four charcoal water filters, I'll distribute them to groups as they pass through.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: With some basic survival and crafting skills, you should be able to make them with little effort.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the charcoal water filters?
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I've been working on producing some of our own medical supplies, but I'm going to need a chemistry set to get everything that I need in order.  Is there any way you could go through one of the school chemistry labs and steal me a chemistry set?
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You might be able to find one in a pharmacy if you can't find a school.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the chemistry set?
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The number of airway infections that I've encountered in the past week has depleted my supply of masks.  Could you find me 10 filter masks?  I tend to only distribute them in severe cases, so I'll be sure to make them last.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You may be able to make one if you had the right guide.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the filter masks?
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: The bodily fluids that I often have to clean up and the caustic chemicals I deal with have done a number on my current pair of gloves.  Could you find me four pairs of heavy rubber gloves?  That should be enough that I can task a few laborers with cleanup details in the event of an outbreak.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You should be able to find them in cleaning closets.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the rubber gloves?
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I heard that we may have a physician on his way here.  The workers have already begun expanding the clinic, but I need you to locate a pair of scalpels to use in surgery when he arrives.  I'm sure you should be able to find them in a hospital or craft shop.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Hospitals and crafting stores should have a few.
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Have you heard of a book called the 'Guide to Advanced Emergency Care?'  I really need a copy.  The doctor is requesting a lot of supplies that I'm not familiar with, but I believe I could make if I could get a copy of the book.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Libraries are the only place I'd think to look.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the Guide to Advanced Emergency Care?
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: We are starting to isolate a few natural antibiotic serums, but we don't have the supplies to administer the cocktails.  I need you to bring me 10 empty syringes to use.  I'll take care of cleaning them to prevent transferring infections.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Hospitals or clinics might have a few sitting around.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the empty syringes?
dialogue.success: Thank you for your assistance.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: I can usually use additional survival gear to kit out the new recruits.  The most basic weapon that everyone gets is the simple knife spear… it provides a good mix of range, power, and ease of use when engaging the more common monsters.  Could you make me a dozen of them?  I may need more later, but that should help the first few teams.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You should be able to make them with the most basic of skills.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the simple knife spears?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Night is the ideal time for my team to go on raids, but they are going to need better light sources to speed up their missions.  Could you craft a set of five headlamps for them?  Keeping both hands free greatly helps during combat.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: You should be able to make them with the most basic of skills.
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: Clothing that can withstand the wear and tear of climbing through windows and fighting back wild animals is in high demand.  The best that we have been able to find is leather body armor, but it is difficult to make with our limited resources.  Could you craft us three pairs of leather body armor?  The life expectancy of my scavengers would drastically increase if you did.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Finding the leather might be easier in town rather than making it yourself.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the leather body armors?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.offer: When outnumbered or forced to pull back, my scavengers have been taught to throw Molotov cocktails to keep monsters from chasing them.  We go through one or two on every mission, so we can always use a few more.  Would you be willing to make us a dozen?  I'm willing to pay you what I can for your assistance.
dialogue.accepted: I'm counting on you.
dialogue.rejected: Come back when you get a chance.  We need skilled survivors.
dialogue.advice: Alcohol or kerosene is probably easier to refine rather than find in large quantities.
dialogue.inquire: Do you have the Molotov cocktails?
dialogue.success: Thank you for the delivery.
dialogue.success_lie: What good does this do us?
dialogue.failure: It was a lost cause anyways…

dialogue.inquire: Have you found the tools yet?
dialogue.success: These will be very useful, thanks!  I found the parts that you needed and can work with the doctor to build the equipment whenever they are ready.
