MISSION_FIND_LIAM.name: Check to see if Liam is OK
MISSION_FIND_LIAM.name_plural: Check to see if Liam is OKs

MISSION_ASSASSINATION.name: Finish your mission
MISSION_ASSASSINATION.description: Your mission required you to eliminate a certain high-ranking individual in hiding.  Your mark seems to have turned feral while escaping and the world appears to be ending, but not even that can stop you from finishing your mission.

MISSION_ASSASSIN_CONVICT_PRISON.name: Kill your mark
MISSION_ASSASSIN_CONVICT_PRISON.description: Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.

MISSION_ASSASSIN_CONVICT_PRISON_ISLAND1.name: Kill your mark
MISSION_ASSASSIN_CONVICT_PRISON_ISLAND1.description: Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.

MISSION_ASSASSIN_CONVICT_PRISON_ISLAND2.name: Kill your mark
MISSION_ASSASSIN_CONVICT_PRISON_ISLAND2.description: Your employer could be no longer responding but you have decided to finish your mission.  Hunt down and kill your mark.

MISSION_PATIENT.name: Life vow
MISSION_PATIENT.description: Live your life to the fullest, prove to yourself that you can survive this new obstacle in the same way that you have survived the last.

MISSION_CLOWN.name: Prepare for your next show
MISSION_CLOWN.description: Become the best clown, make sure that your next show will make everyone laugh by training your social skills to perfection.

MISSION_LOST_SUB.name: Find a memory of your master
MISSION_LOST_SUB.name_plural: Find a memory of your masters
MISSION_LOST_SUB.description: Find and wield a whip to remember your master even when separated.

MISSION_BLACK_BELT_GOAL.name: Obtain your black belt
MISSION_BLACK_BELT_GOAL.description: You could have become a master in martial arts if you had the chance, so train until you achieve the level of a master in the old world, and find yourself a nice black belt to commemorate the occasion.

MISSION_URBAN_SAMURAI.name: Find a real katana
MISSION_URBAN_SAMURAI.description: The world has ended, but as an authentic samurai you lack a katana, you must find one, quickly.

MISSION_FIND_RIFLE.name: Find a new rifle
MISSION_FIND_RIFLE.description: When you were escaping an evacuation point that was overrun, you had to leave your rifle behind.  Shame on you, what's a hunter without their hunting rifle?  You have to find one immediately.

MISSION_DOG_LOVER.name: Protect your canine friends
MISSION_DOG_LOVER.description: You have saved your dogs from the fall of the world, but they could still suffer from danger everywhere.  Police dogs used some Kevlar harnesses for protection…  Maybe your friends could use some too?

MISSION_HUNTER.name: Hunt big game
MISSION_HUNTER.description: The end of the world could have arrived, but you still crave for that one big hunt.  Search and kill a black bear to remember the old days.

MISSION_OTAKU.name: Become the protagonist
MISSION_OTAKU.description: The world has become like an anime!  Zombies, mutants, the end of civilization as we know it…  You must become the protagonist if you want to survive, the plot armor will help you.  Go and kill 50 zombies to show your protagonist potential.

MISSION_MAFIA_BOSS.name: Make the cops pay
MISSION_MAFIA_BOSS.description: They wanted to put you behind bars, but are now dead, make them pay with blood, unliving blood.

MISSION_MUTANT_VOLUNTEER.name: Continue with your evolution
MISSION_MUTANT_VOLUNTEER.description: Your evolution to a more perfect form was interrupted by the Cataclysm.  Restart your transformation process whatever it costs.

MISSION_PORTAL_TRAVELER.name: Recover a part of yourself
MISSION_PORTAL_TRAVELER.description: They took away something from you, something important.  You feel a connection with this weather, maybe you can recover some portion of what you lost in one of these storms.

MISSION_SOCIAL_BUTTERFLY.name: Social butterfly
MISSION_SOCIAL_BUTTERFLY.description: You have always had good social abilities.  Go and recruit 2 followers and establish your leadership among them.  Don't forget to order them to build a base of operations for you in the form of a survivor camp.

MISSION_NINJA.name: Kill your rivals
MISSION_NINJA.description: As a real ninja, you can't allow competitors for the night.  Kill 10 shady zombies and demonstrate who is the real ninja here.

MISSION_COSPLAY.name: Find some cosplay suits
MISSION_COSPLAY.description: The world could have ended, but there are still some fantastic costumes out there, just waiting for you to wear them.  Search them until you find them.

MISSION_SKATES.name: Find some skates
MISSION_SKATES.description: You are a skater at heart, and as such you need some skates to drive by, any kind will suffice.

MISSION_STYLISH.name: Dress with style
MISSION_STYLISH.description: You need to always dress in style and fashion.  Find a dress or tuxedo for your personal use.

MISSION_GAME_MASTER.name: Find a tabletop game
MISSION_GAME_MASTER.description: As a Game Master, it's just unacceptable that you now lack your means to play.  Find any tabletop game to play with any survivors you could find, even a cards game will suffice.

MISSION_MANSION_START.name: Ready or Not
MISSION_MANSION_START.description: Survive all day from the crazy inhabitants of the mansion.

MISSION_HELICOPTER_REFUEL.name: Refuel your helicopter.
MISSION_HELICOPTER_REFUEL.description: You were flying towards a nearby private airport before your forced landing.  You could still reach it by ground, and scavenge it for fuel.

MISSION_HELICOPTER_CRASH.name: Return to base
MISSION_HELICOPTER_CRASH.description: Your helicopter was crashed to the ground, communications were lost with ground base, and the rest of your team died while landing, at least you still know the way back to the base.

MISSION_HELICOPTER_PILOT.name: Go to the refueling stop
MISSION_HELICOPTER_PILOT.description: Your bird is now on the ground, never again able to fly, you could search for a new one in the closest refueling stop requisitioned by the military.

MISSION_LAST_DELIVERY.name: Deliver Your Cargo
MISSION_LAST_DELIVERY.description: You're not sure who orders takeout when the world's ending, but that doesn't matter.  Evacuation doesn't matter.  Nothing, indeed, matters, save for safely delivering your precious cargo to its destination: a remote mansion.

MISSION_KILL_NEMESIS.name: Kill your pursuer
MISSION_KILL_NEMESIS.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can outrun it but never truly escape it.  It won't end until one of you dies.

MISSION_SURVIVE_NEMESIS.name: Survive your pursuer
MISSION_SURVIVE_NEMESIS.description: Since the start of the Cataclysm, something has been hunting you relentlessly.  You can fight it but never truly kill it.  It won't end until you die.

MISSION_FIND_LABYRINTH_SPIRE.name: Investigate the green light
MISSION_FIND_LABYRINTH_SPIRE.description: You don't know where you are, but in the distance you see a jagged spire, with a green light atop it.  Perhaps you should climb this spire and investigate?  What else do you have to lose?

your_followers.name: Your Followers
your_followers.description: The survivors who have entrusted you with their well-being.  If morale drops, poor performance and mutiny may become issues.

amf.name: AMF
amf.description: The survivors who formerly entrusted you with their well-being, but have now mutinied because of your abuse and incompetence.  They will kill you if they can.

robofac.name: Hub 01
robofac.description: The surviving staff of Hub 01, a pre-Cataclysm research lab.  They rarely leave their lab, if at all, and rely on their robots and advanced technology to survive.

robofac_auxiliaries.name: Hub 01 Ancilla
robofac_auxiliaries.description: A loose association of skilled wastelanders, traders, mercenaries and scouts.  All working on behalf of Hub 01, for their own reasons.

robofac_auxiliaries_chop_shop.name: Strip Mall Mercenaries
robofac_auxiliaries_chop_shop.description: A team of mercenaries working for the Hub 01, and operating out of a local strip mall.

balthazar_fac.name: Balthazar
balthazar_fac.description: A mysterious figure who operates out of a bunker.  They're trying to restore some semblance of infrastructure.

old_guard.name: The Old Guard
old_guard.description: The remains of the federal government.  The extent of their strength is unknown but squads of patrolling soldiers have been seen under their banner.

free_merchants.name: The Free Merchants
free_merchants.description: A conglomeration of entrepreneurs and businessmen that stand together to hammer-out an existence through trade and industry.

lobby_beggars.name: The Beggars in the Lobby
lobby_beggars.description: A collection of mentally and physically disadvantaged survivors who beg for food in the Evac Center lobby.

tacoma_commune.name: The Tacoma Commune
tacoma_commune.description: An outpost started by the Free Merchants to provide a source of food and raw materials.

isolated_artisans.name: Isolated Artisans
isolated_artisans.description: A couple of talented artisans in the country.

marloss.name: Marloss Evangelists
marloss.description: Diverse bands, congregations and organizations with the common goal of preaching human survival through symbiosis with fungaloids.

no_faction.name: No Faction
no_faction.description: A lone wolf, not aligned with any faction.

wasteland_scavengers.name: The Wasteland Scavengers
wasteland_scavengers.description: Autonomous bands or individuals who make their living raiding the ruins of the old-world for gear and provisions.

hells_raiders.name: Hell's Raiders
hells_raiders.description: The largest gang of hooligans and bandits that preys upon other survivors.  Even if you have no gear, there is always a need for slaves and fresh meat.

slaves.name: Enslaved individuals
slaves.description: Individuals who have been enslaved or held prisoner for a long period of time, for various reasons.

isherwood_family.name: Isherwood family
isherwood_family.description: A small family surviving on their generational land.

gods_community.name: New England Church Community
gods_community.description: A small group of churchgoers that formed a community in the woods.  They welcome anyone in their faction, but hate the unnatural.

lapin.name: Rabbit Enthusiasts
lapin.description: Mr. Lapin and any acolytes he may have gathered in the apocalypse.

fisherman_family.name: Fisherman Family
fisherman_family.description: A small family trying to survive in this new world.

prisoners.name: Prisoners
prisoners.description: Former prisoners who got their freedom during the apocalypse.

exodii.name: The Exodii
exodii.description: A tribe of scavengers and survivors that have been through this before, and sacrificed what they must to make it through.

the_great_library.name: The Great Library
the_great_library.description: A group of academics and other survivors that stand together to preserve and spread knowledge of the world.

GM_militia_faction.name: Grey Moose Militia Community
GM_militia_faction.description: A small community of survivors who retreated to a remote lodge.

Three stars!  You triple your money!
Three sevens, JACKPOT!  You get 100 times your bet!

effect.u_message:
You dream you can fly over a vast plain of grass, mist in the air, clouds obscuring the sun.  You see "home," whatever that means.  But there are other places.  Sad places.  And a dark place.

Are you a traveler?  An explorer?  Do you find them?  Or do you enjoy your time here?  Do you just sleep it away?

You awake in bed.
The NRE recorder emits a sharp beep!

effect.fail_message: Nothing seems to change.
effect.success_message: The screaming rage of the portal storm folds in upon itself.

effect.u_message: You are trapped in <global_val:place_name>!

You can faintly feel the real world, somewhere in a direction you couldn't name, a fragment of reality in this unearthly place.  With enough effort, you could follow the trail back to the world you left behind.
The sound of footsteps fade.  It's no longer tracking you.

effect.fail_message: You feel a prickle at the edge of your senses.
effect.success_message: Your surroundings warp and fold into the recesses of another world.

effect.u_message:
During the worst of the portal storms you found yourself exposed, and existence as you knew it folded in upon itself.  It's hard to know how long you were floating through a clawing nothingness.  But you've now come to your senses… somewhere else.

All around you is a shallow sea, expanding endlessly under a harsh air and a scarlet sky.

After regaining your footing, you notice something in the distance: a tall, jagged spire, and a green light atop it.

Could this be your salvation?

else.u_message: The world around you folds in on itself - zwoink.  Then, you hear three soft chimes, and find yourself standing in a metal ring.  A tall, bulbous computer screen looms before you, slightly too tall to comfortably look at without craning your neck.  Text starts to populate the screen.

effect.u_message: Something causes you to stop and reflect.  This place look exactly like you remember.  Yet, you don't recall ever being here.  Something has changed from how it was just a moment ago.  You feel it.

false_effect.u_message: A thought passes through your mind:  after all that, are you still you?

effect.u_message: Something causes you to stop and reflect.  The sky here is a perfect grey gradient.  It doesn't change, only deepens.  The world has transformed in some way.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  Something creaks in your mind's ear.  It sounds more like settling than aging.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  The air here smells clean.  Just… clean.  Something has changed.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  For a moment, you feel like you're supposed to think about something.  It passes.  Something is different.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  It's warmer today.  Emotionally.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  There's a faint sense of waiting.  Not yours.  Something in this place has changed.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  Lights soften a moment and stays there.  This place spites the dark, as if it has just transformed itself.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  You think about leaving, but the world doesn't suggest a direction.  Yet, something is different, today.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  You feel like you've been here longer than you have.  Have you?  Something has changed in this world.
Something causes you to stop and reflect.  This place seems exactly the same, today.  You almost wish it didn't.
